  • Degree (or equivalent) in mechanical/building services engineering or related discipline.
  • Eligibility for, or progress towards, corporate membership (MCIBSE, MIMechE or MIHEEM) — Ramboll provides chartership support.
  • Strong competence in digital design delivery (Revit/BIM 360) and familiarity with MEP industry tools.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to run multiple projects or workstreams and manage technical and commercial risks.
  • Clear, confident communicator able to explain complex technical concepts to clients and multidisciplinary teams, verbally and in writing.
  • Self‑starter who can work autonomously across technical aspects of mechanical engineering while building client relationships.

Company overview

This advertisement is specifically for Maverick United Consulting Engineers ("Maverick"), an engineering consultancy based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. 

Maverick United Consulting Engineers ('Maverick') is an engineering consultancy providing specialist structural, infrastructural and value engineering consultancy services for the built environment.

Over the years, from conceptual design to detailed construction drawings to construction supervision, we have delivered and completed structural and infrastructural solutions for projects up to a value of USD200mil. Maverick United provides elegant structural solutions for buildings through globally connected world-leading engineering professionals.

From our bases in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia we have been delivering structural, infrastructural and value engineering designs for building projects located in Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Australia and the United Kingdom.

Maverick is a member of Leighton Asia, which is a member of CIMIC Group. Leighton Asia, a leading international construction company headquartered in Hong Kong, delivers a portfolio of high-profile infrastructure projects throughout Asia.

We invite high-calibre candidates to fill the Mechanical Engineer position in Malaysia and be based at Maverick United Consulting Engineers, Bukit Jalil. KL.

Job Duties

  • Prepare, develop, and review mechanical designs, drawings, specifications, calculations, and equipment selections for projects.
  • Coordinate mechanical interfaces with architectural, structural, electrical, ELV, and other building services disciplines.
  • Prepare design deliverables including basis of design reports, schematics, layouts, equipment schedules, specifications, and tender documentation.
  • Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, and technical queries, and provide technical support during construction and installation works.
  • Support testing, commissioning, equipment start-up, functional testing, and handover activities, including reviewing as-built drawings and O&M manuals.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 to 8 years of Mechanical Engineering design experience, preferably within an engineering consultancy environment.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC, ventilation, chilled water, pumping, piping, and associated mechanical systems.
  • Experience in design development, design reviews, technical coordination, and multidisciplinary project delivery.
  • Familiarity with relevant standards (ASHRAE, SMACNA, BS/EN), BIM tools such as Revit and Navisworks, and testing & commissioning activities

The position requires a flair for innovation and design as well as proven analytical and problem solving skills.

The Group is involved in the development of future aerospace, security and defence systems.  Areas of application include: structural design of electrical, optical and electro-magnetic devices and mechanisms; analysis of systems subject to harsh operating environments; and the development of thermal management solutions.

 

Tasks Include:

  1. Receiving, interpreting and clarifying instructions from customers or colleagues and providing feedback and design input to help develop the design concept.
  2. Designing and detailing design solutions based on information received and one’s own work.  Designs will be developed using CAD systems by producing 3D solid models of the parts and assemblies involved, supported by calculations and analysis where appropriate, then producing mechanical drawings and other data to facilitate manufacture and assembly.

  4. Production of design descriptions and performance reports for design review and communications with the customer.

  • To provide a mechanical engineering design service and to promote and demonstrate best practice when using the BAE SYSTEMS preferred toolsets.
  • Innovating to develop new technology and techniques associated with mechanical design and thermal management.

  • Reporting findings clearly and concisely, both written and verbal.

jobDescription:
Job Description Summary

This is an opportunity to work as part of cross-functional team to deliver product designs that meet customer and project requirements in close conjunction with Electrical and Mechanical Engineers and collaborate with Customers and Project Management, Sourcing and Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams.

Job Description

At GE Vernova's Rugby site, we engineer some of the most technically demanding rotating electrical machines in the industry — equipment that underpins critical energy infrastructure around the world. As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you'll take a leading role in the structural and mechanical design of large electrical machines, applying advanced finite element analysis (FEA) and prototype testing expertise to ensure our machines perform reliably across the most demanding operating environments.

This is a role for an experienced mechanical engineer who understands the unique challenges of rotating machine design — someone who combines rigorous analytical capability with practical engineering judgement and the confidence to collaborate across customer, manufacturing, and project teams to deliver real-world solutions.

What You'll Do

You'll lead and contribute across the full mechanical design lifecycle — from requirements capture through to prototype testing and design documentation. Specifically, you will:

  • Lead mechanical machine design — specify, design, and engineer the mechanical aspects of large rotating electrical machines; interpret and resolve contractual and technical requirements in a timely, quality-focused manner; and create and submit design documentation to communicate and record design progress.
  • Drive structural analysis and simulation — lead detailed analytical and finite element analysis (FEA) programmes using ANSYS/Workbench to assess mechanical stress, fatigue, and structural integrity across a range of machine designs and operating conditions.
  • Improve machine performance and competitiveness — lead design model and prototype test programmes to characterise and improve noise and vibration behaviour; investigate new materials and manufacturing methods to enhance machine competitiveness and long-term reliability.
  • Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams — work closely with customers, third parties, electrical engineers, project management, sourcing, procurement, manufacturing, and quality teams to understand requirements and deliver effective mechanical design solutions.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence — apply and develop knowledge of relevant industry standards and engineering design processes; identify opportunities to advance mechanical engineering tools, methods, and practices across the team.

Who We're Looking For

You're an experienced mechanical engineer with a strong background in structural analysis and rotating machine design, proven FEA capability, and the confidence to lead technical programmes and work effectively with customers and cross-functional partners.

Required

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline. A formal qualification is relevant to the depth of analytical and design work required in this role; however, we are equally interested in your total experience and professional achievements — significant, proven experience in a rotating electrical machines engineering environment will be considered.
  • Significant experience in mechanical engineering for rotating electrical machines, including structural design, analysis, and development.
  • Proven expertise in 2D and/or 3D finite element analysis (FEA) for mechanical designs, including stress and fatigue analysis, using tools such as ANSYS/Workbench.
  • Strong working knowledge of rotating electrical machines — their mechanical engineering challenges, structural characteristics, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards including International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO) 9000, BS EN, and International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 60034.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Willingness to travel and work flexibly in line with project and business requirements.
  • Legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom (visa sponsorship availability will be assessed based on business and legal requirements).

Preferred

  • Sole British Nationality and current or previous Security Check (SC) clearance (certain project activities may require this — see note below).
  • Experience with product lifecycle management (PLM) or enterprise resource planning (ERP) software such as Teamcenter or SAP.
  • Experience in scheduling, planning, and programme management in an engineering environment.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills with a track record of delivering results in cross-functional team environments.

🔒 Security Clearance Note: Some aspects of this role may involve access to information or facilities requiring UK government Security Check (SC) clearance. Candidates who hold or have previously held SC clearance, or who are eligible to obtain it, are encouraged to apply. SC clearance requires sole British Nationality. If you are unsure whether this applies to your situation, please speak with the recruiter.

Why GE Vernova

GE Vernova is a global energy technology company on a mission to electrify and decarbonise the world. Our Rugby site is a centre of expertise in power conversion and rotating machine technology — working on programmes that directly support the energy transition at scale. You'll join a team of specialists who combine deep technical knowledge with a genuine drive to innovate, and you'll have the space to lead, learn, and grow.

At ENGIE, we accelerate the energy transition by harnessing renewable energy sources that make a real difference. Our anaerobic digestion facilities turn organic waste into clean energy, and we need skilled people to keep them running at peak performance.

 

We are looking for a hands-on Maintenance Engineer to join our team at Gorst Energy AD Plant. You will play a vital role in keeping critical infrastructure operational, reducing downtime, and driving continuous improvement. If you thrive in a practical, fast-paced environment and want your work to contribute to a sustainable future, this role is for you.

 

Summary of what you will do

 

  • Carry out preventative and reactive mechanical maintenance to maximise plant uptime and operational efficiency.
  • Diagnose complex technical and mechanical faults on critical plant assets, performing root cause analysis and producing corrective action reports.
  • Develop and implement proactive maintenance procedures and strategies alongside the Maintenance Manager to reduce unplanned failures.
  • Monitor IT control systems, respond to alarms, and produce operational reports, including remote monitoring during on-call periods.
  • Manage permits to work, oversee third-party contractors on site, and ensure full compliance with health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Support plant operations including feedstock loading, weighbridge duties, daily checks, and site housekeeping to maintain a safe and organised environment.
  • Coordinate spare parts stock control, supplier relationships, and purchase order processes to eliminate downtime caused by lack of materials.

 

What you will bring to the role

 

  • A relevant qualification in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (apprenticeship, City and Guilds, NVQ, HNC, HND, or equivalent proven experience).
  • Solid experience in mechanical maintenance within an industrial or operational plant environment.
  • Good knowledge of anaerobic digestion or similar process-driven systems.
  • IOSH Managing Safely certification and strong understanding of health and safety management, including risk assessments and safe systems of work.
  • First Aid/Fire Warden holder
  • Telehandler licence and experience operating plant machinery.
  • Additional certifications such as confined space, PASMA, or IPAF are desirable.
  • Excellent diagnostic, analytical, and IT skills with the ability to interpret data and solve process issues.
  • A proactive, hands-on attitude with strong communication skills, resilience, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Full UK driving licence

 

Location

 

Gorst Energy AD Plant – On Site. This role includes weekend working as part of a team rota. Ideally you will be located within 30 minutes of the plant. A full UK driving licence is essential.

 

What We Offer

 

  • A competitive salary with clear career progression pathways within ENGIE's growing renewable energy portfolio.
  • A diverse range of missions combining mechanical maintenance, process optimisation, and operational support — no two days are the same.
  • Stimulating, meaningful work that directly contributes to the UK's clean energy goals.
  • A friendly, collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and mutual support are valued.
  • Training and development opportunities including specialist certifications and safety qualifications.
  • Flexibility within the rota structure, supporting work-life balance alongside operational needs.

 

Our Commitment

 

At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!

 

ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We evaluate applications based on skills, experience, and potential — regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

 

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs so you can perform at your best.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.
This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.
The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

EOT’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. This role will not require shift work.

Responsibilities:
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment
- Troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to include: filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements

- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)

The Balance of Plant Commissioning Engineer’s role will evolve during the lifecycle of the project and combine technical knowledge with project delivery skills. At the early stages you will contribute to detailed planning and preparation, including reviewing contractor produced

commissioning documentation. Following this, you will execute commissioning tests and conduct surveillance on contractor-led activities as part of a team and analyse the results to justify the readiness of the HPC units to safely enter commercial operation. 

As a Commissioning Engineer you will be responsible for the delivery of test specifications and safety documentation during preparation for commissioning. You will perform site testing safely and effectively, assist with the analysis of commissioning results, resolve problems and take responsibility for ensuring that deliverables supporting HPC commissioning are provided on time, in accordance with the Project’s requirements. This will include giving support to contract partners and taking part in contractual review and acceptance activities.

  • Commissioning of HPC systems.  
  • Provide information to assist the Commissioning Manager in meeting project-level objectives and milestones.

  • Strong technical knowledge of Mechanical & Process Systems with strong technical engineering skills and problem solving skills
  • Must have good ICT literacy (familiarity with using Excel, using Sharepoint, using Review & Comment functions in Adobe & Word, and adaptability to other software packages used on the project such as Switch/ Fieldview/ Navisworks 3D modelling)
  • Good communication skills and the ability to convey complex information to others and able to work as part of a team and work closely with contractors.
  • Delivery focus – either a track record of delivery or a delivery mind-set.
  • Demonstrable history of working within safety and quality cultures.
  • Not essential, but greatly advantageous, working knowledge/experience of UK power industry Electrical & Mechanical Safety Rules. At a minimum must have a working knowledge/experience of permit-to-work systems and lock-out/tag-out systems in heavy industry

About Us

Gardner Denver Transport provides equipment which efficiently transfers bulk material from road tankers and other vehicles. We are seeking a highly motivated Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Bradford. This position offers genuine engineering variety, close collaboration with manufacturing and direct involvement in bringing designs into production.

 

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge of hydraulic, pneumatic and basic DC electrical systems would be advantageous
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Right to work in the UK

 

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

Predominantly site-based at our Bradford facility, supporting close collaboration with manufacturing and assembly operations. Occasional UK travel to customer and supplier locations will be required to support project development, technical reviews and product implementation. Key Competencies

  • Strong mechanical design and problem-solving capability

jobTitle: Senior Data Center Engineer, Mechanical Engineering
jobDescription:
Remote location: United Kingdom.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in mission critical facility design and construction environments.
  • Experience in mechanical infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or other relevant fields, or a Professional Engineering (PE) license.
  • Experience in estimating, mechanical design, operation, and commissioning of mission critical data center mechanical equipment.
  • Experience in design, construction, and commissioning of mechanical cooling plants, fire suppression systems, fuel oil systems, domestic water systems, and sanitary sewer systems.
  • Experience in designing complex modular building scale assemblies, with an understanding of mechanical tolerances and tolerance analysis.
  • Knowledge of mechanical engineering and design principles in the areas of design for medium-scale production, structural beams/elements, and international building codes.
  • Operational knowledge of construction safety procedures.

About the job

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

As a Senior Data Center Engineer, you will be an integral member of the Data Center Delivery and Engineering (DCDE) team which is a collection of Civils Structure, Architecture (CSA), and Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP) design experts, mechanical and electrical field engineers, construction project managers, water/air experts, commissioning experts, data center services managers, and cost and project controls managers who design, schedule, construct, commission and close out the most efficient data centers in the world, at a fast-pace, safely and in a scalable manner.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Define data center system-level, product architecture, and research and development, while helping to develop operations and maintenance procedures for systems/processes.
  • Conduct engineering analysis and research designs and methods of data center equipment and facilities.
  • Ensure designs and installations meet requirements (e.g., predicted cooling, structural, operational concerns, etc.).
  • Provide technical leadership to the projects, support and optimize project design, scope, schedule, quality, commissioning, and safety for the Mechanical discipline, and provide feedback to the central partner teams on possible improvements.
  • Provide mechanical technical leadership, resolving critical field issues.

Role Overview:

We’re seeking a hands-on, time-served Mechanical Engineer to join our flow measurement laboratory. You’ll install flow meters, assemble and fit pipework, and carry out wider mechanical maintenance across our test rigs and laboratory systems. If you take pride in precise workmanship, tidy installs and safe, methodical lab practice, we’d love to hear from you. 

What you’ll do:

  • Assemble, fit and install pipelines, flow meters and associated mechanical components to engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Install flow meters within laboratory test setups; support test runs and functional checks.
  • Perform routine and reactive maintenance to keep mechanical equipment and rigs operating reliably and efficiently.
  • Work closely with engineers and technicians to develop and improve mechanical systems and pipework for lab testing applications.
  • Conduct inspections, pressure/leak tests and functional checks on assemblies, pipework and meters; complete test/inspection records.
  • Follow company procedures and all Health, Safety & Environmental requirements; maintain a clean, organised laboratory workspace.

About Linxon

Linxon is a joint venture between Hitachi Energy and SNC-Lavalin, specializing in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) delivery of electrical substations and grid infrastructure projects worldwide. At Hinkley Point C, Linxon is responsible for the delivery of critical high-voltage electrical infrastructure supporting the UK's newest nuclear power station.

 

Position Overview

The Construction Manager will lead all site construction activities associated with the delivery of Linxon's electrical balance-of-plant infrastructure at Hinkley Point C. The role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant execution of construction works, including civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical installation activities.

 

The successful candidate will provide leadership to multidisciplinary construction teams and contractors while maintaining alignment with nuclear safety standards, project schedule commitments, quality requirements, and budget objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities

Construction Leadership

  • Lead all onsite construction activities.
  • Drive a strong safety-first culture aligned with HPC and Linxon requirements.
  • Ensure construction works are delivered in accordance with project specifications, programme, quality requirements, and approved methodologies.
  • Coordinate daily site operations across multiple contractors and interfaces.
  • Provide visible leadership and direction to construction supervisors and contractor management teams.


Health, Safety, Environment and Security

  • Promote and uphold the highest standards of health, safety, environmental, and nuclear safety performance.
  • Ensure compliance with CDM Regulations, HPC site rules, permit-to-work systems, and Linxon HSE procedures.
  • Lead construction safety reviews, inspections, audits, and toolbox talks.
  • Investigate incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support achievement of Zero Harm objectives.


Project Planning and Delivery

  • Develop and implement construction execution strategies.
  • Monitor progress against baseline schedules and identify recovery actions where necessary.
  • Coordinate resource planning, logistics, material deliveries, and site access requirements.
  • Participate in schedule reviews and construction readiness assessments.
  • Manage construction risks, constraints, and interface issues.


Contractor Management

  • Manage principal contractors, subcontractors, and specialist installation teams.
  • Monitor contractor performance against safety, quality, productivity, and schedule metrics.
  • Review contractor work packs, RAMS, lift plans, and construction methodologies.
  • Facilitate coordination meetings and drive resolution of construction challenges.
  • Ensure adequate supervision and competency management across all work fronts.


Quality Assurance

  • Ensure all construction works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs, and quality standards.
  • Support inspection and test activities.
  • Manage punch list closure and handover documentation.
  • Ensure non-conformances are identified, recorded, and resolved effectively.
  • Promote a right-first-time approach to construction execution.


Interface and Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with HPC delivery teams, EDF stakeholders, designers, commissioning teams, and regulatory representatives.
  • Coordinate interfaces between civil, mechanical, electrical, and commissioning activities.
  • Support project reporting and provide regular updates on construction performance.
  • Represent Linxon in client and stakeholder meetings as required.

 

Commercial and Performance Management

  • Support cost management and forecasting activities.
  • Monitor productivity and resource utilization.
  • Identify change opportunities and constructability improvements.
  • Contribute to project KPI reporting and performance reviews.

 


Qualifications

Essential

  • Degree or HNC/HND in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline.
  • SMSTS Certification.
  • Strong understanding of Construction Design & Management (CDM) Regulations.
  • Full UK Driving Licence.


Desirable

  • Membership of CIOB, ICE, IET, APM, or equivalent professional body.
  • Nuclear industry qualifications and training.
  • Temporary Works Coordinator certification.
  • NEBOSH Construction Certificate.

 

Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience managing large-scale industrial, infrastructure, power, utility, or energy construction projects.
  • Proven experience delivering HV electrical infrastructure, substations, grid connections, or EPC projects.
  • Experience managing multiple contractors in a highly regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated leadership in achieving high safety performance standards.
  • Experience managing complex construction interfaces and stakeholder relationships.


Desirable

  • Previous nuclear industry experience.
  • Experience working on Hinkley Point C or major UK infrastructure projects.
  • Knowledge of ONR and nuclear quality requirements.

 

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on one of Europe's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
  • Career development within a global EPC organisation.
  • Collaborative and safety-focused working environment.
  • Competitive salary, bonus, pension, and benefits package.

Why Join Us?

For more than 60 years, nuclear power stations in the UK have been quietly keeping Britain fuelled with massive amounts of home-grown energy.

Our teams up and down the country are proudly continuing to serve the nation – but they also have an eye on the future.

EDF is leading the UK's nuclear renaissance with the construction of a new nuclear power station at Hinkley Point C and plans for a new power station at Sizewell C in Suffolk.

It takes a special kind of person to work in the nuclear energy industry and although we have thousands of them there’s always a need for more.

Our industry has a mind-boggling range of opportunities and more jobs, and in more places, than you might think. But it’s also an industry which is changing.

We’re a responsible business and proud to be Britain’s biggest generator of zero carbon electricity. With size, age and experience, we believe we can do even more.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. Who are MYT Shutters?


MYT Shutters is an international shutter manufacturer with over 300 people across the UK, Europe, Australia and China. For over 20 years, we've focused on designing, developing and manufacturing high-quality window shutters for the trade market.


Manufacturing is at the heart of what we do. We operate our own production facilities in China and Australia, giving us direct control over how our products are developed, manufactured and continuously improved. Our range includes our own patented product innovations and manufacturing solutions, developed by a small, experienced team with a strong focus on quality, precision and practical problem-solving.


We’re bringing manufacturing to the UK.


Our ambition is to become the UK's number one trade supplier of shutters — and establishing our own UK manufacturing operation is a major part of achieving that.


This is an important next step for MYT. UK manufacturing will allow us to produce closer to our customers, increase capacity, improve lead times and give us greater control over production as the UK business grows.


We're not taking over an established factory. We're building the operation from the ground up.

That means setting up the machinery and production flow, establishing processes and quality standards, building the production team and creating an operation capable of scaling significantly as demand grows.


We're looking for a Production Manager who wants to play a central role in making that happen.



The role specifics


This is a hands-on Production Manager position with responsibility for taking our new UK manufacturing operation from setup through to day-to-day production and future scale-up.


Technical Training in China


Your role will begin with 21–28 days of intensive, hands-on training at our established manufacturing facility in China, working directly alongside the experienced production teams who manufacture MYT products every day.


This will give you first-hand knowledge of our complete manufacturing process at its source, including:

  • Machinery, tooling and production software
  • End-to-end manufacturing processes
  • Product specifications and quality standards
  • Machine setup, operation and diagnostics
  • Preventative maintenance
  • Troubleshooting and minor repairs
  • Production workflows and operating procedures


The objective is for you to return to the UK with a thorough technical understanding of MYT products, machinery and manufacturing methods, ready to implement these standards within the new UK operation. Flights, accommodation, meals, translator support and required business expenses will be provided by MYT.


Setting Up UK Production


Following your training, you will take responsibility for establishing the UK production operation and preparing it for live manufacturing. Working closely with the wider MYT team, you will be responsible for:


  • Setting up tooling, machinery and production workstations
  • Establishing an efficient production flow
  • Implementing and developing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Establishing quality control procedures and standards
  • Planning production and build schedules
  • Managing stock holding and rotation
  • Recruiting and training the initial production team
  • Ensuring operators are trained to use machinery safely and correctly
  • Building a production environment capable of consistently meeting required lead times and quality standards



Running & Developing the Operation


Once production is live, this will remain a hands-on management role. You'll be expected to understand what's happening on the factory floor, work alongside the production team when required and continuously look for opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and output.

You'll take ownership of preventative maintenance procedures and be the first point of escalation for machinery and tooling issues, including troubleshooting, diagnostics and minor repairs to minimise production downtime.


Quality control ultimately sits with the Production Manager. Shutter manufacturing requires tight tolerances, accuracy and consistency, and you'll be responsible for ensuring our processes, SOPs, maintenance standards and team performance continue to deliver the level of quality our customers expect.


The operation will start relatively small, but we expect production demand to increase significantly throughout 2027 and beyond. As volumes grow, you'll help develop the operation through increased capacity, additional production staff and shifts.


About you


We're looking for an experienced, practical Production Manager who is comfortable taking ownership and enjoys solving problems on the factory floor.


A woodworking/manufacturing background is important, alongside experience in:


  • CNC machinery
  • Creating and implementing SOPs
  • Manufacturing and production processes
  • Quality control and working to tight tolerances
  • Production planning and build scheduling
  • Stock management and rotation
  • Preventative maintenance and machinery troubleshooting
  • People management, including recruitment, training, HR responsibilities and policy enforcement


Experience within the window coverings or shutter industry would be an advantage, but isn't essential. We will consider candidates from other manufacturing backgrounds who have the right technical and operational experience.


This role would suit someone who wants more than simply managing an established production line. You'll have the opportunity to help shape a new manufacturing operation from its early stages and develop your responsibilities as the UK business, production capacity and team grow.

Carbometrics is a Bristol-based chemistry company designing and synthesising highly selective binding molecules for cutting-edge sensors used in hospitals, medical devices, bioprocessing and industry. Our mission is to help people with diabetes and other conditions live longer, more comfortable lives through better real-time monitoring of analytes such as glucose.


Built on over 20 years of research from Professor Anthony Davis' group at the University of Bristol, our proprietary Biomimetic Glucose Binding Molecules (GBM) underpin a glucose sensing platform capable of delivering a market-leading Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM). The same core technology, developed through our predecessor company Ziylo, was acquired by Novo Nordisk to develop smart insulins. We've since expanded into potassium, lactate, pH, CO₂ and calcium, building toward the most comprehensive continuously monitored sensor array for medical use.


We're based at Science Creates, Bristol's leading scientific incubator, alongside a highly motivated team of scientists.


Role Overview

Carbometrics is introducing an ISO 13485 Quality Management System (QMS) to support the development and manufacture of our products. As Quality Manager, you'll establish, embed and own the QMS from the ground up, building the foundations of a quality function that scales with the company.


This hands-on, high-ownership role suits someone who enjoys building something new, is comfortable working independently and with external consultants as the sole quality specialist in a small team, and wants to shape how quality is done as we move toward regulatory submission and product launch.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the introduction and maintenance of our ISO 13485 QMS, including document control, record-keeping and change control
  • Define, implement and improve quality processes, procedures and forms suited to a growing start-up, working with the wider team
  • Chair management review meetings and ensure actions are completed
  • Plan and lead the internal audit programme, and lead preparation for and hosting of external, supplier, certification and notified body audits
  • Own the non-conformance, CAPA and root-cause investigation process, ensuring timely resolution and tracking trends
  • Manage supplier and vendor qualification, quality agreements and supplier quality performance
  • Act as main quality contact for suppliers, contractors, auditors and, as we grow, notified bodies or regulators
  • Support science and engineering teams with QC testing, incoming material inspection and routine data review
  • Maintain a strong safety and quality culture, including timely reporting and investigation of incidents, non-conformances and learning events
  • Report on quality performance and QMS status to leadership, recommending improvement priorities
  • Keep procedures up to date as the company, products and QMS mature
  • Build strong relationships across a small, cross-functional team as a trusted advisor on quality and compliance
  • Help build out the quality function as we grow, identifying where more resource is needed
  • Contribute ideas to improve personnel safety, environmental performance and process quality

What You'll Bring

Qualifications:

  • BSc in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (e.g. Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biomedical or Chemical Engineering), or equivalent
  • Further qualification or equivalent experience in quality management, e.g. MSc in Quality Management or ISO 13485/9001 lead auditor training

Essential skills and experience:

  • Proven experience implementing and/or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, ideally ISO 13485, ISO 9001 or equivalent (e.g. IATF 16949, AS9100)
  • Experience owning document control, record-keeping and change control, and producing high-quality documentation (SOPs, work instructions, risk assessments, forms)
  • Experience planning and leading internal audits, and preparing for and hosting external audits or certification assessments
  • Experience managing non-conformances, root-cause investigations and CAPAs through to effective closure
  • Strong numeracy, literacy and computer skills, with close attention to detail
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
  • Ability to work independently as the sole quality specialist, using sound judgement and handling ambiguity as new processes are established
  • Significant practical laboratory or manufacturing experience, in academia and/or industry, including standard health and safety practices
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence quality culture across a science and engineering team

Desirable skills and experience:

  • Familiarity with ISO 13485:2016, including its application to a start-up or first-time device manufacturer
  • Experience with QC testing of samples and processes (e.g. characterising incoming reagents and standards) and reviewing the data
  • Experience with maintenance, calibration and qualification of instruments and equipment
  • Awareness of the medical device Product Development Process and standards such as ISO 14971 (risk management), IEC 62304 (software) and IEC 62366 (usability)
  • Awareness of ISO 10993 for biocompatibility
  • Experience acting as or supporting a Management Representative, or preparing a company for its first regulatory or notified body assessment

What's On Offer

  • The opportunity to build and lead the quality function as the company scales
  • A base at Science Creates, working alongside a motivated team of scientists
  • The chance to shape quality at a company developing market-leading glucose sensing technology

Additional Information

You must be authorised to live and work in the UK. This role is office-based five days a week.

Closing date for applications is 6th October 2026, unless the role is filled earlier.

The Role

The Validation Engineer will be responsible for the planning, execution, documentation and maintenance of validation and verification activities across the company’s manufacturing operations.

The role covers the validation and verification of manufacturing equipment, processes, tooling, test methods, software, facilities and associated systems used in the manufacture of medical devices.

The Validation Engineer will work closely with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs and other relevant departments to ensure that equipment, processes and systems are appropriately qualified and remain in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, develop and execute validation and verification activities in accordance with approved procedures, validation plans and the company’s Quality Management System.

  • Support internal, customer, Notified Body and regulatory audits relating to validation and engineering activities.

Experience and Knowledge

Working at Medasil

Automation Engineer – Food Manufacturing Environment (Danish Crown)

Role Purpose

The Automation Engineer is responsible for the reliability, safety, optimisation, and continuous improvement of industrial automation and control systems within Danish Crown’s food manufacturing environment.

The role ensures stable and compliant operation of automated production and utility systems in line with food safety, quality, and health & safety requirements. The position works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, and IT. IT infrastructure and enterprise systems remain owned by the IT function; this role provides operational input, coordination, and system expertise to support them.

Key Responsibilities

Automation & Production Systems

  • Develop, maintain, and optimise PLC, HMI, SCADA, and MES‑related automation systems supporting production performance (e.g. OEE, SAP PM interfaces).
  • Troubleshoot automation, electrical, and process control issues across production and utilities.
  • Ensure high availability and reliable performance of automated equipment in a regulated food environment.
  • Act as the production automation interface to IT by providing requirements, impact assessments, testing support, and coordination for system changes.

Food Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure automation solutions comply with HACCP, hygienic design principles, and Danish Crown standards.
  • Support QEHS compliance, legal obligations, and internal governance.
  • Participate in risk assessments, validation, and controlled change processes for automation changes.

Continuous Improvement & Reliability

  • Drive CI initiatives targeting efficiency, uptime, yield, and waste reduction.
  • Apply RCA, FMECA, RCM, and CBM methods to reduce recurring failures.
  • Support LEAN ways of working, site performance boards, and problem‑solving routines.

CAPEX & Project Delivery

  • Provide automation input to CAPEX projects including scope definition, functional specifications, commissioning, and handover.
  • Coordinate with IT where projects affect IT‑managed systems.
  • Manage suppliers, system integrators, and contractors within the automation scope.

Maintenance & Technical Governance

  • Support specialist automation maintenance activities and standards.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs and work instructions.
  • Act as CMMS (SAP PM) super‑user from an automation and maintenance perspective.
  • Support design reviews, upgrades, and obsolescence management.

Collaboration & Capability Building

  • Work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, quality, and IT teams.
  • Train and coach operators and technicians in automation systems and process optimisation.
  • Support peer‑site collaboration and external supplier engagement.

Required Education & Experience

  • Degree in Automation, Electrical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering or a relevant technical apprenticeship with strong automation specialisation.
  • Experience in automation or engineering roles within food, FMCG, or regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Hands‑on experience with PLC, HMI, SCADA, MES environments and CMMS systems (preferably SAP PM).

Technical Knowledge & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of HACCP, hygienic design, and food manufacturing constraints.
  • Experience with reliability engineering and LEAN principles.
  • Structured problem‑solving, strong communication skills, and the ability to challenge constructively.
  • Solid digital literacy and ability to work effectively alongside IT‑owned systems.

Engineering SAP Specialist

Role Purpose

The Engineering SAP Specialist is responsible for the accurate creation, maintenance, and governance of engineering master data and planned maintenance activities within SAP.

The role fully supports the Engineering Systems Planner, ensuring data quality, standardisation, and effective use of SAP to enable maintenance execution, engineering planning, cost control, and continuous improvement. The position acts as the SAP super‑user and gatekeeper for Engineering, driving compliance, training, and best practice usage across the engineering function.

The role works closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Continuous Improvement, and Finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Engineering Master Data & Governance

  • Create, upload, and maintain all engineering-related master data in SAP, including:
    • Engineering parts and bills of materials (BOMs)
    • Equipment and functional locations (where applicable)
  • Own data accuracy, structure, and compliance with agreed standards.
  • Act as SAP gatekeeper for Engineering changes, ensuring controlled data creation and updates.

Planned Maintenance & Engineering Systems Support

  • Create, upload, and manage Planned Maintenance routines in SAP (task lists, maintenance plans, frequencies).
  • Ensure PM strategies align with engineering standards, reliability requirements, and CI objectives.
  • Provide full cover for the Engineering Systems Planner during absence or holidays, ensuring continuity of planning and system support.

Reporting, Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Run standard and ad‑hoc SAP reports to support:
    • Continuous improvement of parts booking accuracy
    • Quality of maintenance feedback and failure coding
    • Cost control and engineering performance insights
  • Analyse SAP data to identify improvement opportunities and support CI initiatives.
  • Work with Engineering and CI teams to improve data quality, processes, and system usage.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

  • Work closely with:
    • Engineering and Maintenance teams

  • Support audits, reviews, and governance activities related to maintenance systems and data.

Required Education & Experience

Education

  • Technical or engineering-related qualification preferred (Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, or equivalent experience).

Professional Experience (Essential)

  • Proven, hands‑on experience in a similar SAP Engineering / Maintenance Systems Specialist role.
  • Strong practical experience using SAP for:

With production now underway at JDR's brand new facility in Cambois, Blyth, we've had a number of maintenance roles approved and are looking to recruit an experienced Maintenance Controls Technician to join our team. Reporting to the Maintenance Team Leader, the Controls Technician will maintain and repair equipment within designated areas to ensure that production priorities are met, and equipment performs to its optimum capacity. The successful candidate will work to strict safety and quality requirements to ensure that the machinery used to manufacture our product is running to its maximum efficiency and output. The main responsibilities of the role include:

• Safety First – promotes and adheres to the JDR safety policies and procedures.
• Define, plan, perform and document all maintenance activities utilizing the site CMMS system and other appropriate systems
• Carry out diagnosis of faults, planned maintenance and repairs to all types of plant and equipment in a safe, timely and professional manner and return equipment to operational service
• Estimate length of time required to complete a job and likely consequences of failure to complete work within required timescales
• Identify and escalate any activity that has the potential to cause harm or damage

The successful candidate will also be able to read and interpret engineering drawings and hold an understanding of lean manufacturing including the 5S process. In addition, the candidate will be able to work under minimum supervision with the ability to communicate effectively with staff at all levels.

As the dedicated Quality Control (QC) Technician you will provide independent quality inspection and verification across the SensArray manufacturing process, covering incoming materials, in-process production activity, and final outgoing product release. 


The role is responsible for ensuring that products, components, substrates, documentation, cleanliness standards, meet defined requirements before progressing through production.


Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities


Incoming Quality Control

  • Inspect incoming materials, substrates, components, consumables, and supplier documentation against defined specifications. 
  • Confirm correct part numbers, revision levels, quantities, packaging condition, and traceability requirements. 
  • Identify, quarantine, and escalate non-conforming or suspect material before release to production. 
  • Maintain accurate incoming inspection records and support supplier quality follow-up where required. 

In-Process Quality Control

  • Perform quality checks across SensArray production lines, including High Temp, Etch Temp, TC, RTD, and DISIS, to confirm products and processes meet applicable standards. 
  • Verify operators are working on current SOPs, work instructions, process controls, and quality requirements. 
  • Conduct routine quality gates, process audits, and workmanship checks during key manufacturing stages. 
  • Monitor ESD, cleanliness, documentation, and product handling standards across the production area. 
  • Support containment activity and stop escalation when quality risks are identified. 



Outgoing Quality Control 

  • Complete final inspection of finished products before shipment. 
  • Review product quality records, test data, manufacturing documentation, labelling, and traceability. 
  • Confirm products meet customer, internal, packaging, and shipping requirements before release. 
  • Approve, reject, or escalate product release decisions based on inspection outcome. 

Non-Conformance & Quality Improvement 

  • Raise and support Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for identified defects or process failures. 
  • Assist with containment, root cause investigation, corrective action, and preventive action activity. 
  • Track recurring issues, quality trends, and defect data to support continuous improvement. 
  • Work with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to reduce risk and improve process capability. 



Skills & Experience


Essential 

  • Previous Quality Control or Quality Assurance experience within an electronics manufacturing environment. 
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and quality requirements. 
  • Experience performing visual, dimensional, documentation, or final product inspections.

Desirable 

  • Experience in semiconductor, electronics, clean manufacturing, or high-reliability production environments. 
  • Knowledge of ESD controls, cleanroom practices, ISO 9001 quality systems, SPC, and quality metrics. 
  • Experience using microscopes, metrology equipment, or other inspection tools. 
  • Understanding of root cause analysis and continuous improvement methodologies. 

Qualifications

  • HNC qualification or equivalent technical qualification would be advantageous

Maintenance Electrician


Location: Whatley
Hours: Full Time | Permanent
Salary: £55,000pa plus paid Over time


Powering Performance. Keeping Operations Running.

Are you an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer or Electrician looking for a challenging role within a busy industrial environment?

At Heidelberg Materials, we're looking for a skilled Maintenance Electrician to help maximise the reliability, availability, and performance of our plant and equipment. Working as part of an experienced maintenance team, you'll play a key role in ensuring our operations run safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive individual who enjoys fault finding, problem-solving, and working with a wide range of electrical systems and technologies.


What You'll Be Doing

As a Maintenance Electrician, you will be responsible for carrying out planned and reactive maintenance activities across site, helping to minimise downtime and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing faults and carrying out electrical repairs on plant and equipment.
  • Performing preventative and corrective maintenance to maximise operational reliability.
  • Supporting plant inspections, maintenance shutdowns, and improvement projects.
  • Assisting with the implementation and commissioning of capital projects.
  • Maintaining compliance with Health & Safety, IMS, and site procedures.
  • Liaising with supervisors and operational teams on technical and safety matters.
  • Supporting the development and management of critical spare parts strategies.
  • Recording maintenance activities using SAP PM systems.
  • Participating in occasional weekend and night working during planned and emergency maintenance activities.

Technical Expertise Required


Electrical Installation & Power Distribution

  • Working knowledge of LV and HV electrical systems.
  • Experience inspecting, testing, and maintaining switchgear, transformers, and cable systems.
  • Understanding of electrical protection systems, fault-level analysis, and earth fault protection.
  • Experience working to current electrical regulations and industry standards.

Motors, Drives & Controls

  • Installation, maintenance, and fault-finding on AC/DC motors.
  • Experience with soft starters, slip-ring motors, squirrel cage motors, and liquid starters.
  • Knowledge of variable speed drives (VSDs) and motor control systems.
  • Understanding of motor vibration analysis and bearing systems.

Instrumentation & Automation

  • Experience with process instrumentation and calibration activities.
  • Knowledge of weigh systems, load cells, level control devices, gas analysers, and PID controllers.
  • Fault finding on PLC-controlled systems and associated SCADA platforms.
  • Experience with Allen Bradley, Siemens, Modicon, or similar control systems would be advantageous.

Safety & Compliance

  • Experience working with safety-critical systems and interlocks.
  • Understanding of PUWER and electrical safety regulations.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards in an industrial environment.

What We're Looking For

You will be a practical, self-motivated individual with strong troubleshooting skills and a commitment to safe working practices.


Essential Requirements

  • Recognised electrical qualification.
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic experience gained within an industrial, manufacturing, quarrying, or heavy engineering environment.
  • Computer literacy and experience using maintenance management systems.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.
  • Flexible approach to working hours when operational requirements demand.

Desirable

  • SAP PM experience.
  • EPIC certification for mobile plant operation.
  • NVQ Level 2 in Mobile Plant Operations.
  • Knowledge of industrial gases.
  • Practical welding and burning experience.
  • Experience within the aggregates, cement, quarrying, recycling, or heavy industrial sectors.

Matillion is building the agentic data team

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding and manual data engineering cannot keep up. Maia is our AI agent for data engineering. It builds and manages the data products teams depend on, multiplying what a whole data team can deliver. Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack already run on it.


We started in Manchester and we are now global, with teams across the UK, US and India, and fifteen years of data expertise behind us. We have raised over $300M from some of the world’s best investors, including General Atlantic, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Battery Ventures.


We move fast, hold a high bar, and sweat the details. If you want to do the best product work of your career on a genuinely hard AI problem, this is the place.



About the Role



As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a significant slice of the Maia product, working at the intersection of complex user problems, AI capability, and commercial impact. We need someone who understands what a great agentic product experience looks like and holds the bar for it relentlessly.


You will be user-obsessed and data-driven in equal measure. You define what success looks like before you build, run evals to hold Maia to a high bar, and use AI in your own workflow to move faster. We're not prescriptive about your background: what matters is that you can move fast like a startup and scale with discipline like a larger company, and you know the difference. Most of all, we're looking for depth: the instinct to get to the heart of a hard problem and own it end to end.


Great product work happens through collaboration. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to build Maia, and with GTM to take it to market and turn what you learn into what you build next.


What you will be doing:





  • Own a core area of Maia end to end: define the problems worth solving, prioritise ruthlessly, make the hard trade-offs with incomplete data, and drive the work through to measurable impact.




  • Set the quality bar for agentic behaviour: build the evals that measure how good Maia really is, interrogate the outputs, and hold the line when it isn't there yet.




  • Deeply understand our users: get past feature requests to the real friction in a data team's workflow, and the moments that earn trust.




  • Work at the frontier of the stack: reason with Engineering about models, context, tools like MCP, and orchestration, and where each one changes the product.




  • Accelerate your own output with AI: use AI tools actively across research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, always finding ways to move faster without trading away quality.




  • Drive cross-functional alignment: work day to day with Engineering and Design, keep GTM ahead of what's shipping, and present your roadmap and priorities clearly to stakeholders, leadership and customers.





What we are looking for:





  • A track record of shipping and scaling B2B products. You have built, launched, and grown products people love.




  • Real fluency with how modern AI products work. You are familiar with evals, agentic workflows, context, and tools like MCP, and you have clear judgment about where AI earns its place and where it does not.




  • A systems thinker. You see how the pieces fit together and balance craft, speed, and commercial impact.




  • Sharp judgment under ambiguity. You turn incomplete information into crisp decisions, defend them, and change your mind when the evidence changes.




  • Deep data literacy. You are fluent with metrics and let evidence, not opinion, drive the call.




  • Excellent communication. You articulate a clear vision, bring cross-functional teams with you, and present with credibility to leadership and customers.




  • Strong product instincts and taste. You stay close to the user, know what great looks like, and hold the bar for it.




  • Bonus: data domain knowledge. Exposure to data integration, warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks), or analytics is a plus, not a requirement.

jobTitle: Senior Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions
jobDescription:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Global FX and Cross-Border Solutions team is charged with leading the strategy, design, build, and commercialization of best-in-class flexible enterprise-wide FX and Cross-Border solutions as we seek to meet the growing and increasingly diversified needs of clients moving funds around the world.

What’s it all about?

The Senior Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions is responsible for defining and executing the roadmap for issuer-focused FX and Cross-Border capabilities, driving product strategy from concept through execution while partnering closely with technology, operations and regional stakeholders. The successful candidate will leverage deep knowledge of Visa capabilities and systems, while translating business objectives into scalable product solutions through detailed requirements, transaction flows, prototypes and technical designs. The role requires strong product thinking and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate and prioritise product investments, balancing client needs, technical feasibility and strategic objectives to ensure resources are focused on the initiatives that deliver the greatest client, commercial and long-term business value.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Gen AI tools (e.g. Replit, Copilot, Figma AI, Claude Code etc) to enable everyday work.

What We Expect Of You, Day To Day.

Product Design & Solution Architecture

  • Own and manage the development of customer-centric product requirements for issuer FX and multicurrency solutions by leveraging AI-powered tools to rapidly define, iterate, validate, and refine product concepts. Transform client needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into prioritized requirements, AI-generated prototypes, workflow-models, user stories, process flows, and scalable solution designs using AI tools.
  • Design end-to-end solutions that align business objectives, client requirements and technical capabilities.
  • Develop transaction flow diagrams, system interaction models, wireframes and solution prototypes to support product development and stakeholder alignment.
  • Drive requirements gathering and translate complex business problems into clear and actionable technical requirements.
  • Work with Technology, Processing and Architecture teams to assess solution feasibility, dependencies and implementation considerations.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to convert strategic product opportunities into scalable technical solutions.
  • Lead client workshops, design sessions, solution reviews and architecture discussions throughout the product lifecycle, translating market and client needs into validated product concepts and scalable technical solutions that support successful delivery.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Prioritisation

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer and multicurrency product strategy.
  • Identify strategic opportunities through client engagement, market research, competitive analysis and industry developments.
  • Evaluate product initiatives and investment opportunities based on client value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, scalability and strategic alignment.
  • Develop business cases, market assessments and value frameworks to support investment and prioritisation decisions.
  • Partner with regional, commercial and product teams to gather market insights and validate investment opportunities.
  • Assess build, buy and partner opportunities to address product capability gaps, recommending the optimal approach based on strategic, commercial and technical considerations, and supporting partnership commercials, contracting and execution.
  • Recommend product roadmap priorities, sequencing and investment allocation based on expected business impact, resource constraints and strategic objectives.
  • Support annual planning, portfolio reviews and investment discussions with senior leadership.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption and commercial outcomes, using Gen AI and data-driven insights to refine strategy and prioritise future investments.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, including issuer processing, FX mechanics, multicurrency solutions and cross-border transaction flows.
  • Demonstrated experience working with payment processing platforms and technologies, including VIP, BASE II, authorisation, clearing, settlement and transaction lifecycle management.
  • Experience designing and documenting complex solutions through BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, transaction flows and solution design documentation.
  • Experience working with multi-currency, wallet, FX or banking platforms such as Currencycloud is highly desirable.
  • 5-8+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, payments, FX, multicurrency solutions, issuer processing or cross-border payments.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements, solve complex business and technical problems, and translate them into scalable product solutions.
  • Experience partnering with Technology, Processing, Operations and Architecture teams to deliver product enhancements and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience supporting product roadmap development, business case creation, revenue drivers, financial models and portfolio prioritisation.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking and prioritisation skills, with the ability to assess opportunities based on client value, commercial impact, technical feasibility and strategic alignment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience working within global, matrixed organisations and collaborating across regional and cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% (regional and global).

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Before you apply: this role requires recent, hands-on experience owning a workforce, resource or crew scheduling product (things like shift scheduling, time & attendance, capacity planning or absence management) as a genuine Product Manager or Product Owner, not a Business Analyst, Programme Manager or delivery lead working to someone else's requirements.

If your closest match to this domain was a short stint, or is more than a few years back, this likely isn't the right role for you.

Job Description

People, skills and operational resources are critical to success in construction, engineering and other project-driven industries. Organisations must balance productivity, compliance, utilisation and cost while ensuring the right resources are available at the right time.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to contribute to the strategy, discovery and delivery of operational workforce and resource management solutions for Construction & Engineering and adjacent industries.

You will drive product initiatives from discovery through adoption, working closely with customers, engineering, design and industry experts to validate opportunities, build business cases and deliver measurable outcomes.

Based in the United Kingdom, the role has a global remit across North America, Europe and APMJA. You will work closely with customers, partners and internal teams to identify opportunities, validate needs and deliver solutions that create measurable business value.

This role requires strong product leadership, strategic thinking and a passion for applying AI, automation and emerging technologies to solve complex workforce and operational challenges.

What You Will Do

Contribute to Product Strategy

  • Contribute to product strategy and shape roadmaps for designated product domains and investments.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends and industry insight into focused investments.
  • Balance customer value, commercial opportunity and platform evolution.
  • Deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

Drive Customer and Market Discovery

  • Engage directly with customers to understand challenges, priorities and outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers, partners and industry experts.
  • Validate opportunities before investment decisions are made.
  • Establish design partners and lighthouse customers to support discovery and adoption.

Define the Product

  • Translate customer problems into product outcomes, experiences and success measures.
  • Drive prototyping, validation and iterative discovery.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams.
  • Leverage AI to accelerate discovery, innovation and product definition.

Deliver Outcomes

  • Build evidence-led investment cases.
  • Drive initiatives from discovery through adoption.
  • Support positioning, launch and customer engagement.
  • Measure success through adoption, customer outcomes and business impact.

Shape the Future of Workforce Management

  • Champion an AI-first mindset, identifying how automation, intelligence and agentic experiences can transform workforce-intensive industries.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify work through intelligent automation.
  • Explore new interaction models and user experiences.
  • Ensure AI-enabled capabilities deliver trusted, measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with customers to shape the next generation of workforce experiences on IFS Cloud.

Qualifications

Essential Experience

  • Product management experience delivering SaaS, workforce management, resource management, field service or enterprise software solutions.
  • Experience contributing to product strategy, roadmaps, discovery, delivery and adoption.
  • Experience with workforce planning, scheduling, time and attendance, resource management, labour compliance, payroll integration or workforce analytics.
  • Understanding of operationally intensive industries such as Construction & Engineering, Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, Telecommunications or Field Service.
  • Experience working with global customers
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and design teams.
  • Fluent English and willingness to travel internationally.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with workforce management, resource planning, scheduling, payroll, HCM or operational workforce solutions.
  • Experience within construction, engineering, energy, utilities, manufacturing or other project-centric industries.
  • Understanding of workforce productivity, compliance, payroll and workforce analytics.
  • Experience building AI-enabled enterprise software products.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation and agentic experiences.
  • Experience modernising enterprise SaaS products.
  • Exposure to business case development, pricing, monetisation or product P&L ownership.
  • Experience establishing design partner or customer co-innovation programmes.
  • Degree or equivalent experience in business, engineering, computer science or a related discipline.

How You Will Work

You will succeed in this role if you are:

  • Customer obsessed, focused on solving meaningful problems.
  • Outcome driven, prioritising impact over feature delivery.
  • Strategic and commercially minded, balancing customer value with business growth.
  • Industry aware, understanding operational and project-driven organisations.
  • Innovative, embracing AI and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborative, working effectively across product, engineering, design and go-to-market teams.
  • Technically fluent, comfortable discussing data, integrations, platforms and AI.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, bringing clarity to complex challenges.
  • Hands-on, actively engaging in discovery, validation and customer conversations.
  • A multiplier, helping raise the bar for product management.

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

About Us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees.
