Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

This role will be working at the heart of the GoCardless product in our Payment Flows team, within the Bank Payment Network Group. The team ensures that merchant money is settled quickly, with high certainty, on every payment scheme we provide. You will define and build propositions that provide market leading outcomes: building the capabilities to settle money faster, leveraging ML to confirm payments sooner, and unlocking payment capabilities that give merchants the best experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work closely with the team’s Engineering Manager and Data Scientist to lead the product improvements that help our customers and drive revenue. You will also collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Customer Success, and other Product teams to achieve great outcomes for our customers and work towards our product vision.

What Excites You

  • Delivering customer and business value: Being relentlessly focused on understanding and solving the customer problems which result in them using GoCardless as much as they can.
  • Problem discovery and prioritisation: Taking complex and ambiguous product problems and structuring these effectively. This includes clearly defining the problem space, the impact of the problem and your prioritisation process.
  • Data-led decision-making: Using quantitative and qualitative evidence to support your decisions and opportunity identification.
  • Defining Product Strategy: Identifying key customer segments, and our approach to meeting their needs over the longer term in ways that create value for them and GoCardless
  • Influencing and communication: Building collaborative relationships with your team, stakeholders and executives to deliver change effectively across your remit. This includes growing to become the ‘go-to’ person for your product area; translating complex, technical problems into understandable concepts; and convincing stakeholders of the best approach using structured reasoning.
  • Leadership: Setting direction and coordinating action across a range of teams and functions
  • Shipping stuff: Working with your team to support changes to completion, delivering consistent positive impact across your product area. Being comfortable delivering a range of projects: from MVP experiments testing a hypothesis to a new feature.

What Excites Us

  • Delivery of impact: You are focused on delivering business value through experimentation and have experience of doing that.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills: We want our Product Managers to have an outstanding ability to tackle valuable customer and business problems. At GoCardless we start by asking ‘why?’, and a data-led approach is central to how we run Product. You have a customer centric approach and are comfortable with qualitative and quantitative analysis.
  • High agency: We’re after people who aren’t afraid of a challenge and will take ownership of problems they come across and help to resolve them and adapt to a constantly changing environment.
  • Collaborative leaders: Product roles bring responsibility without direct authority. We’re looking for leaders who can motivate and earn the trust of stakeholders and teams with a collaborative approach.

We don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you’re excited by this role, we encourage you to apply.

Specifically, you will progress our Football offer and proposition, working closely with our Quants, Engineering and Trading teams to leverage our internal Football model and differentiate Super from our competitors.

What the role involves

Customer and Competitor Insight

  • Lead on customer understanding, discovery and defining customer value for our products.
  • Leverage AI to drive discovery and utilise customer feedback from multiple touchpoints across the organisation to build a picture of customer problems, opportunities and behaviour.
  • Make data-driven decisions using customer research, behavioural, product and commercial data, working with AI & Data Analysts to develop the reporting capabilities needed to measure customer behaviour and product engagement.
  • Define what success looks like for our product and take responsibility for its measurement in-life, testing and iterating to achieve the product objectives, whilst maintaining ongoing awareness of our key competitors and their offering.

Execution

  • Create best-in-class product features and journeys that take the player experience to the next level, working with engineers and stakeholders to define and deliver reliable, scalable solutions to customer problems.

Influencing People

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Build and maintain a roadmap for your area that delivers short-term and long-term objectives aligned to the overall company and product strategy, driving it from ideation and product discovery through to in-life product.

At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Athlete Performance group. You’ll be responsible for a product suite that supports sports scientists and coaches in capturing and analysing athlete monitoring data—whether from wearables, optical tracking, or other data sources—to mitigate injury risk, optimise athletic performance, and track the physical development of athletes.

As a Senior Product Manager, You’ll

  • Grow our human performance business. You’ll work with a cross-functional team to create a coherent product strategy and vision, connecting it to the wider company strategy and effectively delivering against it. You’ll “quarterback” a key investment, with the goal of building products that customers love and use daily.
  • Advocate for the product. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our customers and our business needs, building trusting relationships with customers and senior internal stakeholders. You’ll also help practitioners tell a fully contextualised story by combining athlete monitoring data with Hudl’s unique video and match analysis assets.
  • Motivate your squad. This is critical—you’ll determine what success looks like and work across multiple functions to turn your product vision to reality.
  • Foster collaboration. While balancing cost, timeline and customer benefit, you’ll also work with Marketing, Sales and Customer Support to develop go-to-market plans.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Experience. You’ve spent more than four years in product management roles within agile software development environments. You can work largely autonomously, and you have a proven track record of delivering valuable customer-facing software.
  • Dependable. You can be counted on to find the right information to make a decision, and you own them after they’re made.
  • Grit. You don’t let setbacks get you down—instead, you come through and deliver for customers.
  • A self-starter. You can balance your time between working with your squad, running discovery and defining strategy. You also know how to get the job done and can roll up your sleeves and get hands on when necessary.
  • AI-native. You leverage AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, sharpen decision-making, enhance communication, and increase delivery velocity. You know how to use AI to prototype ideas quickly, synthesize insights from data and customer feedback, and improve both product strategy and execution while maintaining strong judgment and ownership.
  • A communicator. You’re comfortable presenting, writing strategic documents, and sharing your product roadmap with stakeholders. You can decompose complex problems to bring senior leaders along, gain buy-in for your ideas, and motivate others toward a common goal.
  • Commercially-minded. You have good business sense and know how to balance user needs with business goals.
  • Naturally curious. You never stop learning—you’re eager for knowledge and new ideas because that improves the way you work. You love building prototypes, testing, learning and evolving.
  • Data-driven. You have a passion for using data and insights to drive high quality decision-making, but also know when to take calculated leaps of faith.
  • A proven people leader. You care deeply about your team and want to help them be successful.
  • Collaborative. You’re comfortable working with other teams, seek to understand the strengths of those around you, and have made each team you’ve worked on better. You relish tackling hard problems alongside your squad and building great relationships with teams.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Domain experience. If you’ve worked in the sports technology industry, or have experience in wearables, athlete tracking technologies, and the associated software, that’s a plus.
  • Sports science background. You have hands-on experience as a sports scientist and you bring deep industry context, along with a strong network of professional connections.
  • Innovation. You’ve successfully brought “0 to 1” product initiatives to life, turning concepts into real, impactful solutions.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

jobTitle: Senior Product Manager - Series C Fintech
jobDescription:
Help us build the Homeownership category in fintech.


Tembo is one of the UK's fastest-growing fintechs, helping people save for, buy and own a home. Hundreds of thousands of customers already use Tembo to save and plan for their future, while our mortgage business has grown into one of the UK's leading digital brokers, voted the UK's Best Mortgage Broker five years in a row.


Today, our app is predominantly a savings experience, with mortgages integrated into the journey. We're now bringing those strengths together to build the defining financial platform for homeownership: helping customers save, understand what they can afford, get mortgage-ready, buy their home and make smarter financial decisions throughout homeownership.


We're looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own our Savings app and play a major role in making that happen.


This is a high-accountability individual contributor role. You'll have genuine ownership of one of Tembo's most important product areas, working directly with our founders and alongside engineering, design, data, marketing and commercial teams.


You'll be expected to make meaningful product bets, move quickly and be accountable for the outcomes. You'll own the Savings experience we have today while helping define what it becomes next, including how we bring Savings and Mortgages closer together and use AI to deliver personalised homeownership guidance at scale.


The opportunity

You'll take ownership of a significant consumer product already used by hundreds of thousands of customers, spanning our Lifetime ISA, Cash ISA and HomeSaver® - our market-leading and unique savings product built specifically around homeownership.


But this role is about much more than optimising the Savings product we have today.


You'll help answer some of the biggest product questions at Tembo:

  • How do we help customers understand whether they're on track to buy a home?
  • How do we connect saving and getting mortgage-ready into one seamless journey?
  • How can AI give every customer genuinely useful, personalised guidance on what they should do next?
  • What new products and experiences should we build that don't exist today?


You'll have the autonomy to identify the opportunities, make the bets and the accountability to prove whether they work.


What you'll do

  • Own the Savings product. Take accountability for its strategy, roadmap, customer experience and commercial performance.
  • Make meaningful product bets. Identify opportunities that can materially change growth, engagement or customer outcomes and build the conviction to pursue them.
  • Shape our Homeownership strategy. Help define how Savings, Mortgages and new experiences come together into a more powerful consumer proposition.
  • Shape our consumer AI strategy. Identify where AI can fundamentally improve the way we guide customers and turn those opportunities into real products.
  • Drive growth and engagement. Find ways to help more customers choose Tembo, save more with us and engage more deeply with the product.
  • Set the direction. Identify the problems worth solving and make clear prioritisation decisions rather than managing a pre-defined backlog.
  • Lead cross-functionally. Bring engineering, design, data, marketing and commercial teams together around clear customer problems and outcomes.
  • Get close to customers and data. Build conviction through customer insight, behavioural data and commercial performance.
  • Move quickly and learn. Take ideas from ambiguous problems through discovery, validation, build and launch, then iterate based on what actually happens.
  • Own the outcome. Success isn't shipping the roadmap. It's delivering measurable impact for our customers and the business.


What we're looking for

We're looking for a senior product person who wants ownership rather than management.


You'll likely have:

  • Significant experience building and scaling consumer-facing digital products.
  • A track record of owning meaningful product areas and delivering measurable customer and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience making significant product bets, not just optimising an existing roadmap.
  • Excellent product judgement and a strong instinct for what makes a brilliant consumer experience.
  • The ability to take ambiguous problems, form a strong point of view and turn that into action.
  • Strong analytical instincts and confidence using data to make decisions.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and design teams from discovery through to delivery.
  • A strong point of view on how AI is changing consumer products and the curiosity to turn new capabilities into experiences customers genuinely value.
  • Strong commercial thinking and an understanding of the relationship between customer value and business value.
  • The confidence to challenge founders and senior stakeholders, while knowing when to make a decision, commit and execute.


Experience in fintech, savings, investing or mortgages would be useful, but it isn't essential. We're more interested in people who have built brilliant consumer products and can bring that experience to Tembo.


What this role isn't

This isn't a role where you'll be handed requirements and asked to manage a delivery backlog.

And it isn't a people-management role. Seniority here comes from scope, judgement and accountability, not the number of Product Managers reporting to you. We're looking for someone who wants to be close to the product, customers and data, make difficult decisions and be on the hook for whether they work.


Why Tembo?

This is an opportunity to own a significant consumer product at scale while having an unusually large influence over where it goes next.


You'll join a business with real scale across both Savings and Mortgages, but with a huge amount still to build as we bring those worlds together.


You'll have huge autonomy, huge accountability and direct access to our founders, with the opportunity to make product bets that can materially shape both Tembo and how people navigate homeownership in the UK.


Package

The package includes competitive salary and equity options.

London, UK

  • Technical proficiency with LLMs and AI agents, possessing a deep understanding of their practical applications and limitations.
  • Strong communicator capable of navigating ambiguity and articulating clear logic for product decisions to stakeholders and engineers.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

  • Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
  • Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
  • If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobTitle: Senior Technical Product Manager - API Experience & Security
jobDescription:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.

You’ll focus on reducing partner-impacting incidents (especially auth- and webhook-related), improving observability and self-serve troubleshooting, and modernising the auth and security foundations so the platform can scale safely over the next few years. You will partner and work closely with the Security, Account Access and Wise Platform teams to build API solutions suitable for our enterprise partnerships.

Your mission: Make Wise Platform integrations secure-by-default and reliable in production, with self-serve operational API visibility that reduces failures and support load.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Own the Wise Platform partner API access, webhook service and WP API security offering, making it easy for developers to securely connect and troubleshoot our APIs.
  • Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
  • Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
  • Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
  • Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap

  • Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution

  • Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between scope, security, reliability, and delivery speed.

Collaborate cross-functionally

  • Partner with platform engineering, security, compliance, support, sales, and other product teams to deliver a cohesive partner experience.
  • Align internal teams on ownership boundaries and operational processes for incident prevention and response.

Be customer-obsessed

  • Engage directly with partner developers and operational teams to understand real production pain (auth failures, webhook issues, visibility gaps).

Measure and iterate

Deliver impact

  • Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 6+ years of product management experience, ideally with APIs, platform products, security, identity, auth or infrastructure.

Technical aptitude

  • Strong understanding of authentication and access patterns (e.g., OAuth2, API keys, JOSE, mTLS), identity/access lifecycle, and operational reliability concepts.
  • Comfortable discussing architecture, threat/risk trade-offs, and reliability/observability with engineers.

Customer-centric mindset

  • Empathy for partner developers and operators; you can translate production pain into clear product priorities and outcomes.

Analytical & data-driven

  • Able to set measurable goals and use metrics and incident data to drive prioritisation and iteration.

Execution-focused

  • Track record of shipping impactful platform improvements in complex, cross-functional environments.

Strong communication & collaboration

  • Can clearly communicate technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders, build alignment, and drive decisions.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Description

An accomplished Product Delivery Lead is required to join the Willis Neuron product team. Auquan builds autonomous AI agents that eliminate repetitive work across institutional finance. Our agents power workflows across credit, investment, ESG, and compliance for firms like MetLife, T. Rowe Price, BC Partners, and ERM.

Our constraint is no longer demand — it’s how quickly we can discover, build, and scale new products from real client workflows.

The Role

We’re hiring AI Deployment Strategist with a focus on Sustainability to build new products directly from real client problems.

This is not a traditional solutions or implementation role.

You will:
  • Work directly with senior sustainability stakeholders at top financial institutions
  • Identify high-value, unsolved workflows
  • Rapidly turn those into MVP AI-powered products
  • Drive those products to real usage and measurable outcomes
You are a 0→1 product builder embedded in the customer environment, responsible for turning ambiguous workflows into real, deployed AI products.

Job Responsibilities

You will operate as part of a small Pod, embedded directly with clients and responsible for end-to-end outcomes. You will own delivery and outcomes for your clients, and help define best practices, quality standards, and product direction.

In practice, this means:
  • Owning a portfolio of enterprise financial clients and becoming their go-to partner
  • Running deep discovery: sitting inside workflows, shadowing analysts, joining working sessions
  • Understanding and mapping workflows end-to-end (e.g. credit reviews, investment research, portfolio monitoring)
  • Translating messy, ambiguous processes into structured, multi-step AI workflows
  • Rapidly building MVPs and prototypes; iterating directly with users
  • Working in lockstep with Product Engineers to ship usable capabilities weekly
  • Designing evaluation logic, edge cases, and correctness criteria
  • Driving adoption: ensuring clients can independently use what you build
  • Measuring success via real KPI movement and usage
  • Managing multi-threaded client engagements (business, security, procurement)
  • Expanding usage: identifying new use cases, teams, and opportunities
  • Converting workflows into reusable product components and feeding product direction
  • Work closely with vertical leads to align on what “good” looks like, while maintaining ownership of execution and client outcomes
You are accountable for outcomes, not output — success is defined by whether the client uses what you build and sees measurable impact.

In your first 90 days:
  • You’ve identified and scoped new product opportunities
  • You’ve shipped at least one working MVP with real users
  • You’ve driven adoption and measurable impact
  • You’ve contributed reusable patterns to the product
Over time:
  • You consistently turn client problems into new products
  • You operate independently with strong judgment and ownership
  • You help define what Auquan builds next

  • Proven track record of building products from 0→1: discovery → MVP → iteration → real usage
  • Strong client presence with the ability to guide and influence senior stakeholder conversations
  • Hands-on GenAI fluency (LLMs, workflows, rapid prototyping)

  • Consultant, especially one who built products, not just delivered projects

In a nutshell

At Sainsbury’s we believe that the customer should be at the heart of everything we do. In Logistics Tech, we build the systems that move 3,000 trailers full of stock every day and keep the shelves full for customers across the country, helping to make good food joyful, accessible and affordable for everyone, every day.

 

In your role as a Staff Product Manager for Logistics, you’ll own the vision for some of our most highly complex and valuable products and work actively with multiple teams to make our vision come to life! You will be accountable for developing the strategy for these products and make effective choices to drive maximum value.   You will have an infectious passion for your products, partnering with other Product Managers, Engineering Teams and Architects to define, deliver and iterate your products to find creative ways to deliver awesome experiences for our customers.

 

Specifically, you will be working across the products which power our Logistics Food Network as we go through a multi-year programme to transform our capabilities in Warehouse Management and Transport.

 

We’re big and that's really exciting when you consider the number of colleagues that see your work, but you’ll also ship lots of value to customers, and you’ll be able to learn and iterate quickly to get the best customer experience.

 

What you need to do

As a Staff Product Manager you will:

  • Deliver products with the biggest budgets that bring significant value back to the business aligned to corporate strategic pillars.

  • You will be accountable for developing the vision, strategy, roadmap and backlog for your products, own the customer and business value, and make effective prioritisation choices to deliver maximum value and return on capital, ensuring we meet our corporate plan commitments.

  • Champion for your products – determining the right level or type of material to communicate the experience, benefits and long-term vision across a variety of audiences including development team, stakeholders at all levels, partners and external parties

  • Build highly collaborative relationships with engineering and architecture to successfully navigate significant integration complexity or decisioning as you develop your products. Influence others with varying priorities to drive alignment and pace.

  • Apply insight, data, research, technical product knowledge, to ensure your team are focused on making the biggest difference for customers and the business.

  • Manage levels of risk to minimise vulnerabilities and prioritising development by working with complex and sensitive information.

  • Champion and prioritise tech standards alongside product features in yours and your team’s roadmaps explaining the merits to stakeholders.
  • Advocate for agile software development practices with business stakeholders ensuring a good understanding of iterative value delivery. 
  • Monitor relevant industry trends keeping personal knowledge up to date with the latest developments and innovations pertinent to your products. Build confidence as the subject matter expert for your products, helping to guide future investment.

  • Work collaboratively with engineering teams providing expertise to evaluate potential partner relationships; identifying necessary and/or desirable third-party technology to evaluate and select vendors. 

  • Own your products through the lifecycle, supporting communication and resolution of live product incidents and effectively prioritise, coordinate and communicate the resolution of production issues (bugs)

  • Maintain a good level of awareness, interest and understanding of the existing and stacks/interfaces for your products and how to develop these so they work seamlessly for customers and colleagues 

     

What you need to know

  • Master level of product management process.

  • Proven track record of leading delivery of highly complex technology led change in cross-functional environments; you have shipped products at scale that customers and colleagues love.

  • Good level of knowledge and understanding of the end-to-end Supply Chain, with particular emphasis on Logistics and the technology which powers high performing Logistics Operations

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, particularly at senior levels

  • Working knowledge of technology relevant to Logistics

  • Solid understanding of commercial landscape

 

What you need to show

  • High levels of technical curiosity and comfort being in the thick of technically complex discussions to be able to guide and prioritise next steps using product principles. 

  • Ability to switch between strategic visioning and getting into the detail, being the authority in all aspects of your products

  • Strong leadership and influencing skills, adapting your decision making to different levels of ambiguity and urgency; developing an authentic and consistent leadership style based on a robust knowledge of yourself, influencing without authority

  • Creating a positive and consistent impact with internal and external audiences; excellent stakeholder management skills, ensuring senior stakeholder advocacy for your product at the highest levels of the organisation.

  • Ability to translate business goals, technology strategy and market knowledge into a product roadmap that prioritises delivery of value and enables future business agility 

  • Excellent communication skills and able to articulate complex ideas in an accessible and engaging way.

  • Comfortable with significant ambiguity and will guide definition, prioritisation, and scope, in concert with your and other cross functional teams to drive business outcomes through exploration.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-paced environment where you will set and be held accountable to ambitious goals.

  • Consistently engaging and motivating people with a variety of perspectives around the roadmap for your product; facing into difficult conversations and giving others licence to challenge your perspective

  • Anticipating risks and opportunities, responding to escalations at pace and coaching others to find solutions based on your expertise 

  • A high level of team contribution, seek opportunities to provide input and support across the team and outside core areas of focus including contributing to the product community, role modelling product and agile processes to get to the best outcomes.

 

What decisions I can make

  • All decisions related to delivering the roadmap for your product(s)

jobTitle: Senior Product Manager - Pricing and Billing
jobDescription:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

 

 

We’re currently seeking an experienced colleague to join the team as a Senior Product Manager – Pricing and Billing.

 

 

You’ll proactively lead and deliver Global Payment Solutions (GPS) strategic projects across UK Commercial Banking (CMB), working closely with GPS Europe / Global and CMB UK to deliver a strategic pricing and billing solution.  GPS is a key product provider for the bank’s corporate customers, supporting clients ranging from business banking through to large corporates.

 

 

This position, within the Revenue Management team, was established to review the end-to-end UK pricing and billing landscape for GPS products and implement a strategic solution. You’ll have visibility with senior management, whilst reporting to the Revenue Management team lead, and will have line management responsibility. 

 

 

You’ll define and own requirements for the strategic global revenue management and billing platform, including ownership of the control environment and remediation activity.  There will also be an element of regulatory reporting.

 

 

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

 

 

In this role you’ll:

 

  • Act as a subject matter expert on GPS products whilst leading UK CMB GPS strategic initiatives across pricing and billing, partnering closely with GPS Europe/Global and CMB UK to deliver the billing solution, owning the requirements for the global revenue management and billing platform, including defining needs, signing off requirements, assessing alternative solutions, and making approval decisions based on risk and control considerations
  • Drive simplification for customers, frontline teams, and operations, ensuring proposed solutions improve usability and service outcomes
  • Define the target operating model, roadmap, and strategy for billing across GPS products and services and map end-to-end pricing and billing processes by engaging SMEs (e.g., Product, Operations), documenting process flows, and identifying process/control gaps with clear remediation actions
  • Provide project and management reporting, highlighting trends, product issues, risks, opportunities, and threats, and giving insight that supports risk management and regulatory compliance
  • Own governance for UK GPS billing rules for both product enhancements and new product launches and manage regulatory and audit-related work, including legal/regulatory changes impacting billing/pricing, MSII issue management, RCRA/audit responses and remediation plans, and FCA reporting/redress workstreams where relevant
  • Analyse data to identify remediation needs, including supporting customer refunds/redress activity in line with CMB Customer Redress governance decisions

 

 

 

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

 

  • Demonstrate commercial banking or product management capability, with a solid background in commercial cash management and an understanding of how products perform end-to-end (pricing to invoicing to financial reporting)
  • Experience of delivering payment and cash management product systems deployments required.  Pricing and billing systems experience within the wider banking sector would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of banking operations, payment systems and technology; able to quickly understand complex architectures and translate them into clear requirements and controls
  • Demonstrate analytical and data-driven approach, with advanced Excel capability and confidence working with large datasets to identify outliers, issues, and remediation actions
  • Effective programme/project delivery skills, including planning, prioritisation and the ability to communicate with impact and influence and challenge constructively, building strong relationships across multiple stakeholders and organisational levels
  • Apply a risk and control mindset, anticipating issues, strengthening controls, and ensuring compliance with relevant governance expectations, including the UK Product Governance and Sales policy and fair customer outcomes

 

 

 

 

 

This is a hybrid role based in London.

 

London office relocation: Between January and April 2027, many office-based HSBC employees in London will move from either 8 Canada Square or Queen Victoria Street to one of our new sites at St. Paul’s or Canary Wharf. Depending on when they join, successful candidates may start at an existing office before moving or join directly at a new location. The specific location cannot be confirmed at advert stage and will be discussed during the recruitment process. This does not apply to branch-based or HSBC Innovation Bank roles.

jobDescription:
Who is HSBC Innovation Banking?  

HSBC Innovation Banking is the power behind the UK’s forward-thinkers, future-makers, and leap-takers, helping them ignite the bold ideas that reshape our world. We offer flexible banking solutions for start-ups, scale-ups, growth businesses, investors and those working towards IPO typically within the technology and life science sectors.

Whether it’s comprehensive banking, managing cashflow, plans for buyouts or Strategic Fund Solutions, we power ideas at every stage of their journey. From the first-time founders to the funds that back them, and everything in between. We're proud to accelerate growth for our clients, create meaningful connections and communities, and open a world of global opportunity for entrepreneurs and investors alike.

Here’s to never standing still. Come and join us!

 

The Role

The role is that of a Regional Coverage Manager, responsible for business development, originating new business and growing the regional presence of the bank.  A sector and life-stage agnostic role, giving the individual ultimate flexibility in being able to support the Innovation ecosystem (from Early-Stage banking right through to Late-Stage lending opportunities). 

 

The Team You’ll Work With

Reporting to the Head of Regional Coverage, this role will be based in either Bristol or Bath, with a remit to originate in the West of England and Wales eco-systems.  Candidates with strong connections and the ability to maintain a consistent physical presence in this region would be highly advantageous.

 

The value you will add:

You’ll be responsible for executing on HSBC Innovation Banking's commercial banking strategy, identifying and targeting growth markets, working with internal and external stakeholders to build our brand and product solutions for high-growth companies in the Region. 

This is a business development and highly ecosystem-facing role.  The candidate should convey the entire platform of our services in the target market, be the conduit for companies, founders and investors into our global network and work closely with the UK Relationship and Credit underwriting teams to bring new clients into bank.  This individual will convey the bank's strategic areas of focus to investors and founders in the market as well as educating internal stakeholders on regional opportunities. 

 You will drive new business origination by building deep relationships with the Venture Capital and advisory community and ensure the growth of the HSBC Innovation Banking brand in market - including representing the bank in PR activity, at conferences and ecosystem events.

 

What you can expect to be doing:

Strategy:  Responsible for executing on the HSBC Innovation Banking market strategy in the West of England and Wales. Working alongside internal teams to deliver on this strategy while meeting both quantitative business development targets and qualitative goals.

Brand building: Grow the bank’s brand in local and international markets. This involves speaking at conferences and events, other PR activity and publishing thought leadership content with the aim of increasing our market share.

Channel and Ecosystem development:  Bring the HSBC Innovation Banking network, both internal and external, into the West of England and Wales market for the benefit of the ecosystem.

Cross-Sell: Pro-actively identify and deliver cross-sell opportunities to deepen relationships with prospective clients. Originate and evaluate prospective businesses and work with product partners to help clients scale and succeed.

Debt Execution: The successful candidate will work across internal teams to drive the client onboarding and credit process to a successful conclusion maintaining client contact where necessary to support the ecosystem development in the regions now and in the future.

Proven track-record of operating in the Innovation space, winning new relationships and with an existing network of VCs and high growth companies

Expert Relationship skills with excellent all-round knowledge of banking products, including Treasury, Clearing and Trade Finance Solutions

Validated ability to build meaningful and strategic relationships with CEOs/CFOs and VCs plus other ecosystem players

Experience in selling and strategically positioning a wide range of banking products

Our Mission

Operating within a highly regulated consumer credit environment, you will bridge high-level commercial orientation with technical depth to navigate complex trade-offs, optimise resource allocation, and foster platform capabilities. Strategic Vision & Execution

  • Drive market positioning to maintain product relevance and a distinct advantage.
  • Navigate trade-offs across the product portfolio to optimise resource allocation and market impact.

Capability Building & Tech Pioneer

  • Champion resilient, extensible, and reusable platform capabilities (APIs, Cloud infrastructure, and modern data architectures) that ensure scalability and a competitive advantage.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to challenge and inform technological choices that enable both near-term value delivery and long-term modernization.

Human-Centered Product Discovery

Collaborative Leadership

Principal, Product Management

Role Summary

Nebula is Pearson’s enterprise Product Design System: a shared platform of reusable components, semantic tokens, standards, tooling, and governance that enables product teams to build high-quality, accessible, brand-aligned and AI-ready experiences faster.

Pearson has already demonstrated the value of this model through PLS, including measurable reductions in component-development effort, embedded WCAG 2.2 accessibility, and faster enterprise-wide change. The next challenge is scaling Nebula from a successful system into a durable enterprise capability adopted across Pearson’s products and business units.

As Principal Product Manager for Nebula , you are the senior product leader responsible for turning Nebula’s enterprise vision into an outcome-driven platform roadmap, adoption strategy, and measurable business value .

You partner closely with the Director of Design Systems , who leads Nebula’s system vision, experience and craft strategy, standards, governance, and design/engineering capability. Together, you operate Nebula as an enterprise product—not a component library or downstream service.

Your focus is to make sure Pearson is building the right shared capabilities, for the right consuming teams, in the right sequence—and that adoption produces measurable value.

What You Own

1. Enterprise Product Strategy & Roadmap

Translate Nebula’s enterprise vision into an evidence-led product strategy and prioritized multi-year roadmap.

You will:

  • Co-own the enterprise Nebula roadmap with the Design Systems Director, translating system strategy into product outcomes, initiatives and sequencing.

  • Define the problems Nebula should solve across Pearson’s business units and product portfolios.

  • Prioritize investments across reusable components, platform capabilities, adoption tooling, AI-enabled workflows, Platinum/brand integration and emerging Content/AI needs.

  • Establish clear product hypotheses, success measures and decision criteria before major investments.

  • Balance enterprise standardization against legitimate product and technical differences across consuming teams.

  • Maintain a transparent roadmap connecting investment capabilities adoption measurable enterprise value.

2. Adoption Product Strategy & BU Onboarding

Treat adoption as a product problem , not a communications or change-management exercise.

You will:

  • Segment Pearson products and business units by readiness, compatibility, value opportunity and migration complexity.

  • Partner with BU Product and Engineering leaders to turn interested teams into roadmap-committed adopters with named products, dates, owners and scope .

  • Lead discovery with consuming teams to understand adoption friction, unmet platform needs and migration barriers.

  • Design the end-to-end Nebula adoption experience: evaluation commitment onboarding migration contribution ongoing consumption.

  • Define scalable pilots and onboarding models before expanding enterprise-wide.

  • Use adoption feedback to shape platform roadmap priorities.

  • Partner with Program Management on intake and migration sequencing while retaining product accountability for what and why .

3. Outcomes, Telemetry & Value Measurement

Own the evidence that proves Nebula is working.

You will:

  • Establish the Nebula measurement framework with leading and lagging indicators.

  • Define telemetry for:

  • active products using Nebula

  • component reuse

  • avoided bespoke rebuilds

  • adoption and migration velocity

  • accessibility readiness

  • design-to-code fidelity

  • rebrand propagation time

  • product-development capacity released

  • Create dashboards that allow the central team, BU teams and executives to see adoption and value.

  • Validate assumptions in the business case against real adoption data.

  • Use evidence to stop, change or accelerate investments.

  • Build the product-level evidence required to continuously strengthen Nebula’s enterprise investment case.

4. Discovery & Platform Customer Insight

Build continuous discovery into the operation of the design system.

Your “customers” include designers and engineers, but also Product leaders, accessibility teams, AI teams, Brand, and business units consuming the platform.

You will:

  • Run ongoing generative and evaluative discovery with consuming teams.

  • Identify recurring problems that should become shared enterprise capabilities rather than local solutions.

  • Determine where standardization creates leverage and where flexibility is required.

  • Validate high-value component, workflow and platform opportunities before committing significant central-team capacity.

  • Create feedback mechanisms that allow BU contributions and needs to flow back into Nebula.

  • Turn qualitative customer insight and telemetry into roadmap decisions.

The original Principal PM role’s strength in continuous discovery should stay; its purpose simply shifts from coaching other PMs to directly improving Nebula.

5. Prioritization & Product Operating Model

Create the product discipline that allows a specialized platform team to make high-quality trade-offs.

You will:

  • Own Nebula prioritization and outcome-based backlog management.

  • Establish clear criteria for:

  • platform investments

  • component requests

  • migrations

  • contribution proposals

  • exceptions

  • enterprise versus BU-specific work

  • Partner with the Director, Principal Engineer and discipline leads on roadmap and release planning.

  • Ensure roadmap commitments reflect available team capacity and enterprise value.

  • Convert ambiguous enterprise asks into appropriately sized discovery and delivery increments.

  • Maintain decision traceability from customer problem investment outcome.

jobDescription:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Product Management


Job Description

About CRFS

CRFS, part of Motorola Solutions, is a world leader in radio frequency (RF) technology, providing mission-critical solutions for defence, national security, and regulatory agencies. Our RFeye ecosystem - including ruggedized sensors, direction-finding arrays, and advanced software suites - allows our customers to detect, identify, and geolocate signals of interest in the most complex electromagnetic environments. We operate at the cutting edge of spectrum dominance, electronic warfare, and signal intelligence.

The Role

We have an opportunity for a Senior Software Product Manager to bridge the gap between complex engineering capabilities and real-world customer missions. This is not a "pure" product management role; it also requires some technical understanding of embedded and application software, as well as familiarity with electronic systems for RF mission applications.

You will be the "voice of the system", working closely with our engineering teams to develop innovative solutions to high-stakes problems. You will take ownership for some of our software products (both current and future), ensuring they not only have clear development roadmaps, but also solve the challenges faced by our global customer base and are the best they can be.

Key Responsibilities

  • Software Solutions: Translate customer and partner requirements into actionable software product roadmaps and specifications, working collaboratively with Senior Engineering, Sales and Product Management colleagues.
  • Product Owner:  As the owner and lead for Software Products (application and embedded) you will maintain a coherent roadmap across all software components, including real-time user applications, embedded real-time, APIs, and user-interfaces.  You will develop promotional content for the marketing team, and provide occasional support at trade events.
  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): Support the technical evolution of our RFeye products from concept through to deployment and end-of-life.  Contribute to PLM activities to ensure that RFeye products meet customer requirements, are positioned and marketed effectively and that the CRFS Sales, Customer Support and Application Engineering teams are fully equipped and trained to sell and support them.
  • Bridge Engineering & Commercial: Work alongside software and systems engineers to evaluate trade-offs, ensuring that engineering efforts align with market needs and commercial viability.
  • Market & Application Insight: Develop a deep understanding of use-cases, including TDOA/AOA geolocation, signal capture and analysis, and electronic warfare support.
  • Hands-on Product User:  You will be expected to use our products and become proficient in their use with a view to ensuring they are the best they can be – forming your own judgement on capabilities, improvements and updates using ‘customer eyes’.  You will also engage with end users to elicit their input and feedback.
  • Documentation & Training: Author high-quality white papers, requirement specifications, and user stories. Ensure the Field Application Engineering (FAE) team is fully equipped to demonstrate new system capabilities.


Basic Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: A degree in Engineering (software/electronic/systems preferable) or a related technical field.
  • Industry Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a technical role, ideally within Wireless/RF, Telecommunications, Defence, or Aerospace.
  • Technical Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of RF systems (receivers, antennas, signal processing) and wireless communications.
  • User and Solution Mindset: Proven ability to move beyond "features" and think about customer needs and solutions - how hardware and software interact to solve a specific end-user problem.  A demonstrable ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage trade-offs, and evaluate opportunistic new ideas against current commitments alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Communication and Approach:  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A positive attitude and ability to get things done, whilst being a committed team player.  An ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and clients on product requirements and specifications.
  • Product Management: While we welcome engineers looking to transition, prior experience in product management, technical sales support, or systems engineering is highly desirable.
     

Desirable Skills

  • Direct experience with Spectrum Monitoring or Electronic Warfare (EW) applications.
  • Understanding of deployable equipment use within a harsh or military environments and modern user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools like Jira.
  • The ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders or customers.
  • Source, compile and analyse market, voice of customer and competitor information.


Travel Requirements

Under 10%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

No

Motorola Solutions UK Limited

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. jobTitle: Senior Commercial Product Manager at STRATOS (German)
jobDescription:
About Us

At STRATOS Technologies, we are transforming how companies make data-driven decisions. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, enabling businesses to strengthen their long-term strategies through clear and actionable insights.

Our founders, former business and tech executives who led a $1B division at a Fortune 500 industrial company, originally built a digital twin of their enterprise to drive synchronized planning and execution. Seeing the market’s lack of such a system, they launched STRATOS in 2022 with a bold mission: to unifiy all internal and external data into a single platform.

Today, STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

From commercial AI agents to embedded intelligence that supercharges lean teams, STRATOS enables businesses to achieve 10x productivity and strengthen long-term strategies through actionable insights. We are now expanding our team to accelerate our growth even further and help our customers outperform their competition.

Tasks

  • Lead high-impact customer projects, ensuring our software delivers measurable strategic value
  • Analyze and interpret large datasets to uncover business insights and opportunities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to jointly solve our customer’s most strategic problems
  • Drive strategic initiatives by translating data trends into structured, actionable recommendations
  • Present data findings in an engaging and understandable way to our customer’s executives

Requirements

  • 2+ years of consulting experience at a leading strategy consulting firm
  • Sound understanding and experience of B2B marketing & sales and digital transformation
  • Highly effective communication skills on all stakeholder levels
  • Strong team player and coach
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Driven and reliable with excellent work ethic and high integrity
  • Fluent in English and German

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • B2B business experience in a commercial role, ideally with P&L/ people responsibility

Benefits

  • Become part of a category-defining startup which transforms how industrial companies operate and compete
  • Work alongside a team of former top-tier consultants and Fortune 500 executives
  • A steep but rewarding learning curve that is designed to challenge you and help you grow
  • A highly competitive compensation package
  • Attractive Stock options program, allowing you to share in the long-term success and growth of the company
  • Flexible hybrid and local work options, with the option for visa sponsorship
  • A dynamic, barista-equipped office in the heart of London, designed to foster creativity and collaboration
  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility—we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

ABOUT THE ROLE

Digital is the growth engine that will power John Lewis to become leading again. We have an exciting opportunity as Group Product Lead within our John Lewis Digital team. In this role, you are the intersection between business, technology and user experience, leading multiple teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and drive growth, in line with the JLP Product Framework.

As Group Product Lead for the Availability & Fulfilment team, you will be at the forefront of transformational change as we modernise our digital capabilities to deliver exceptional customer experience and business growth. The successful candidate will be an expert leader, with demonstrable experience of developing the people, process and technologies that drive our most complex digital journeys. You will have a clear vision for the omnichannel experience, with the ability and drive to make this a reality for our customers and Partners.

You will be responsible for managing the product development process from product discovery and truly understanding the tactical and strategic problems that need to be solved
across the business and technology, putting the customer at the heart of your decisions. You will define the area on which to focus and develop products that are desirable, feasible and viable. You will drive innovation and transformation to achieve both customer and business outcomes.

Your success, and that of your product domain, relies on every team member understanding the vision and being passionate about our customers and the direction of travel. You will be responsible for shaping the product strategy for your domain, ensuring all teams can translate the strategy into prioritised and actionable units of work for the Development teams and deliver a best-in-class customer and user experience for business success across multiple digital touchpoints.

You will be expected to lead by example, with a hands-on approach, coaching and developing an expert high performing team.




  • Salary range £76,800 - £110,000
  • Contract type - This position is a Permanent Role

  • Working pattern/flexible working - Hybrid working. Core days for the Digital team are Mondays and Thursdays, with an additional core day TBC working towards more in person

  • Location -  This role is based at our London Head Office campus in Pimlico, and will require a balance between office working and some onsite time in shops, contact centres and supply chain locations.

Essential skills/experience you’ll need


  • Demonstrated ability in Product Leadership, managing value creation and strategy across a mix of 1-5 year Product horizons
  • Comprehensive understanding of shop, supply chain and inventory management technologies and operations, through an internal user, customer and competitor lens
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in multiple locations, with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple priorities while adhering to time-sensitive deadlines
  • Highly commercial and analytical. An excellent communicator and storyteller, able to build trusting relationships with key stakeholders and presenting concepts and ideas in different formats, depending on context
  • Demonstrable evidence of leading large scale transformational change initiatives in areas with high legacy and/or complexity
  • Accomplished people manager, with a history of growing Product Management talent and managing individual, team and 3rd party performance



Desirable skills/experience you may have 

  • Experience with B2C businesses, with an app-first customer experience
  • Operational experience in shops and supply chain

Job Title: Technical Product Owner – Healthcare IoT & Connected Solutions


Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Product Owner to drive the development and delivery of connected healthcare solutions, working closely with Solution Architects, engineering, and customer service teams. This role bridges business, clinical operations, and engineering—owning product direction while translating real-world healthcare service needs into scalable, secure, and usable solutions.


Although this position is listed as a UK-based role, we welcome applications from candidates located elsewhere in Europe and will consider suitably qualified applicants across the region.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap and backlog for healthcare IoT and connected device solutions
  • Translate customer service workflows and field operations needs into product features and technical requirements
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to align product vision with system architecture
  • Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements for engineering teams
  • Prioritize features based on business value, operational impact, and customer experience
  • Drive development of solutions supporting device monitoring, diagnostics, remote support, and service automation
  • Collaborate with customer service, support, and field teams to improve issue resolution and service efficiency
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and HITECH Act in product design
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives)
  • Validate delivered features through UAT, field feedback, and operational metrics
  • Drive integration with EHR/EMR systems, service platforms, and IoT ecosystems
  • Partner with DevOps teams to ensure smooth releases, monitoring, and continuous improvement
  • Track and improve KPIs such as uptime, response time, MTTR (mean time to resolution), and customer satisfaction

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or technical program delivery
  • Strong understanding of healthcare customer service operations (support workflows, ticketing systems, field service)
  • Hands-on experience or strong understanding of IoT / connected devices and edge-to-cloud architectures
  • Technical background in software development or engineering (ability to work closely with developers and understand trade-offs)
  • Experience working with APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps)
  • Understanding of NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch) and data-driven applications
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into technical requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare environments (hospital systems, medical devices, digital health platforms)
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM)
  • Experience with service management platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce Health Cloud, etc.)
  • Exposure to DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, release management)
  • Experience with remote device management, telemetry, and diagnostics systems
  • Background in AI/analytics use cases (predictive maintenance, support automation, knowledge systems)

Key Competencies

  • Strong understanding of customer service workflows in healthcare environments
  • Ability to balance technical depth with product and user experience focus
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and driving clarity
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, operations, and clinical teams
  • Data-driven decision-making with focus on operational efficiency and customer outcomes
  • Ownership mindset with ability to drive product from concept to delivery

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact data initiatives that support a global healthcare business. You'll play a key role in building the foundations for advanced analytics, self-service reporting and AI-driven decision-making while working with modern cloud technologies and a highly collaborative team.


If you're passionate Technical Product Owner who thrives when driving the development and delivery of connected healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Head of Customer Advocacy is responsible for developing and executing customer advocacy programs that strengthen market credibility, validate product positioning, and support commercialization across the Digital Oncology portfolio.
This role serves as the strategic bridge between customers and the business, ensuring customer insights, clinical evidence, outcomes data, and customer experiences are translated into compelling market narratives, validated marketing claims, differentiated go-to-market strategies, and measurable business impact.
The Head of Customer Advocacy will lead advisory boards, customer advocacy programs, consortium initiatives, evidence generation efforts, claims validation processes, and customer reference strategies while partnering closely with Product Marketing, Commercial Strategy, Clinical, Product Management, Communications, Regional Marketing, Regional Sales, Strategic Partnership Managers (SPMs), and Executive Leadership teams.
The role will serve as a central point of coordination between global marketing teams and customer-facing field organizations to ensure customer advocacy, evidence generation, and collaborative innovation initiatives support both global strategy and regional commercial priorities.

Are you passionate about transforming customer relationships into strategic business impact? In this highly visible global role, you'll partner with leading oncology organisations, clinicians, executives, and internal stakeholders to build advocacy programmes, advisory boards, evidence-generation initiatives, and customer communities that directly influence product strategy, commercial growth, and the future of cancer care technology.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how the voice of the customer influences the future of Digital Oncology worldwide. You'll build and lead global customer advocacy programmes, work directly with senior healthcare leaders and oncology experts, generate evidence that supports commercial success, and ensure customer insights help drive product innovation, market strategy, and thought leadership across the business.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Advocacy Strategy


  • Develop and execute the customer advocacy strategy across the Digital Oncology portfolio.
  • Build and maintain a network of customer champions, references, and advocates across oncology provider organizations, health systems, and strategic accounts.
  • Establish scalable advocacy programs that support commercialization, customer engagement, and market differentiation.
  • Ensure the voice of the customer is consistently represented across marketing, product, and commercial initiatives.

Advisory Boards


  • Own the strategy, governance, planning, and execution of Digital Oncology advisory board.
  • Develop annual engagement plans aligned with product strategy, market priorities, and customer needs.
  • Recruit, engage, and maintain relationships with key oncology stakeholders, clinical leaders, and executive customers.
  • Partner with regional sales and marketing teams to identify strategic customer participants and ensure global representation across advisory activities.
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations for Product Marketing, Product Management, Commercial Strategy, and Executive Leadership.

Clinical Evidence & Outcomes Validation


  • Lead initiatives to gather customer-driven clinical, operational, and business evidence supporting Digital Oncology solutions and services.
  • Partner with clinical, product, and commercial teams to identify evidence-generation opportunities.
  • Develop customer case studies, workflow analyses, outcomes assessments, value realization studies, and ROI frameworks.
  • Create and maintain an evidence repository supporting commercialization, customer engagement, and market positioning.

Marketing Claims Validation & Governance


  • Establish and manage processes for validating product and marketing claims.
  • Partner with Legal, Clinical, Regulatory, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure all external claims are evidence-based, supportable, and compliant.
  • Maintain supporting documentation and governance processes for commercial messaging and customer-facing materials.
  • Ensure alignment between customer outcomes, product capabilities, and market positioning.

Consortiums & Customer Collaboration Programs


  • Lead the development and operation of customer consortiums and collaborative innovation programs.
  • Define program objectives, governance models, participation frameworks, and engagement strategies.
  • Facilitate collaboration between customers and internal stakeholders to advance innovation, workflow optimization, and evidence generation.
  • Capture and disseminate insights that inform product strategy, commercialization priorities, and customer success initiatives.

Customer Reference & Thought Leadership Programs


  • Develop programs that increase customer participation in speaking engagements, conferences, publications, webinars, advisory activities, and industry events.
  • Partner with Communications and Marketing teams to amplify customer stories and thought leadership opportunities.
  • Support executive and customer-facing events by identifying advocacy opportunities and customer participation strategies.

Executive Customer Engagement


  • Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Engagement teams to define the strategic objectives, content, and customer outcomes for VIP customer visits, Customer Experience Center engagements, and executive briefing programs.
  • Ensure customer engagement experiences reinforce product value, market differentiation, and long-term advocacy development.
  • Identify opportunities to convert executive customer engagements into advocacy, evidence generation, and strategic partnership opportunities.

Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing to ensure customer insights and evidence support positioning, messaging, launches, and commercialization strategies.
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy to align advocacy programs with growth initiatives and strategic priorities.
  • Work closely with Product Management to incorporate customer feedback into product planning and roadmap discussions.
  • Coordinate with Regional Marketing and Regional Sales teams to identify customer advocacy opportunities, recruit program participants, and activate customer success stories across global markets.
  • Partner closely with Strategic Partnership Managers (SPMs) to identify, engage, and develop strategic customer relationships that support consortiums, collaborative innovation programs, advisory boards, and evidence-generation initiatives.
  • Support SPMs in cultivating executive customer relationships that advance both customer value and broader business objectives.
  • Coordinate with Communications, Clinical, and Executive Leadership teams to maximize the impact of customer advocacy initiatives and thought leadership programs.



Qualifications



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, Radiotherapy or a related field.
  • Experience in customer advocacy, product marketing, healthcare marketing, commercialization, clinical strategy, or related functions.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, oncology, digital health, SaaS, clinical software, or healthcare services organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading advisory boards, customer advocacy programs, or evidence-generation initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to engage senior healthcare leaders, clinicians, and strategic customers.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in oncology, radiation oncology, medical oncology, or healthcare workflow technology.
  • Familiarity with clinical evidence generation, outcomes research, value realization programs, or claims substantiation processes.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, on-premise software, managed services, or healthcare technology solutions.
  • Experience managing customer reference programs, thought leadership initiatives, consortiums, or collaborative innovation programs.

Success Metrics


  • Growth and engagement of customer advocacy network.
  • Number and quality of customer references, case studies, and evidence assets generated.
  • Effectiveness of advisory boards
  • Contribution of customer evidence to commercialization and market positioning efforts.
  • Adoption of validated claims and governance processes.
  • Customer participation in thought leadership and advocacy activities.
  • Impact of customer insights on product strategy and commercialization initiatives.
