We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner, to join our BNY Payments Enablement Enterprise Platform team. This role is located in Manchester, UK. 

  

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: 

The Product Owner will lead the Liquidity Management pod in the Core Processor Group, which is one of the groups within the BNY Payments Enablement Enterprise Platform with the mission to own the execution, orchestration, and lifecycle management of payments across the Payments Enablement Platform, ensuring payments are processed accurately, consistently, and resiliently regardless of rail, product, or channel. This group defines and delivers the core payment behavior that sits between payment intake and payment rail execution.  

Key responsibilities of the Product Owner would be to manage the Liquidity Management pod within the Core Processor group, including 

  • Own and manage the product backlog for the pod, ensuring alignment with platform OKRs and strategic priorities.  

  • Drive product outcomes that strengthen intraday liquidity visibility, funding efficiency, payment prioritization, and control effectiveness across the payment lifecycle. 

  • Partner with business, operations, treasury, risk, and technology teams to evolve liquidity management capabilities that support resilient payment processing and effective exception handling. 

  • Identify opportunities to improve product delivery and operational decision-making through responsible use of data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities. 

  • Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.  

  • Prioritize backlog items to balance new feature delivery, technical debt, and platform resiliency.  

  • Lead sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in partnership with the Scrum Leads and development team.  

  • Ensure solution designs align with long-term architecture and platform vision.  

  • Monitor and measure pod’s performance, using data to inform decisions and continuous improvement. 

  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of payment related information to internal Lines of Business (LoBs), external clients, 3rd party providers and market infrastructures enabling smooth operations, maintaining client trust, and supporting compliance 

 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:  

Education & Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree or work experience equivalent 

  • 10+ years of experience in transaction banking, with at least 5-7 years in a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role. 

  • Proven experience working on payment processing with focus on channels and messaging. 

Domain Expertise 

  • Understanding of end-to-end payment lifecycle. 

  • Strong knowledge of payment rails: wires, ACH, instant payments, and emerging networks. 

  • Strong understanding of payment infrastructures and market utilities (e.g., SWIFT, CHIPS, Fedwire, SEPA, RTP, CHAPS, TARGET2, EPN, FED ACH, etc.). 

  • Strong understanding of payment message formats and standards such as ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, NACHA, and proprietary bank formats. 

  • Knowledge of liquidity management concepts in payments / transaction banking, including: 

  • intraday liquidity 

  • prefunding 

  • funding optimization 

  • account balances 

  • liquidity positions 

  • payment release decisioning 

  • Understanding of how liquidity controls impact: 

  • payment orchestration 

  • payment prioritization 

  • queuing 

  • limits 

  • exception management 

  • Experience across payment types / rails with awareness of liquidity implications for: 

  • real-time payments 

  • high-value payments 

  • batch payment flows 

  • Familiarity with: 

  • nostro / vostro account structures 

  • settlement processes 

  • cash positioning 

  • reconciliations 

  • Ability to work across Treasury, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Engineering 

  • Understanding of: 

  • operational risk 

  • resiliency 

  • controls in a high-volume payments environment 

  • Ability to translate liquidity and payments requirements into: 

  • product features 

  • user stories 

  • measurable business outcomes 

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.  

 

Product Ownership & Agile Skills 

  • Experience as a Product Owner in Agile/Scrum environments, with a solid grasp of Agile principles, ceremonies and backlog prioritization/management. 

  • Ability to write clear and actionable user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage a product backlog. 

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — capable of balancing the needs of operations, compliance, IT, and clients. 

  • Experience collaborating with development teams, testers, and business SMEs to deliver high-quality solutions. 

Technical & Analytical Skills 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to work cross-functionally across business and technical teams. 

  • Ability to interpret operational, liquidity, and workflow data to identify bottlenecks, risk points, and opportunities for automation or optimization. 

  • Ability to analyze trends and use data to inform product decisions and drive operational efficiency. 

  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, Excel, and data visualization tools. 

 

AI literacy and understanding how AI can support: 

  • product management 

  • workflow optimization 

  • decision support 

  • analytics 

  • operational efficiency 

  • Ability to identify practical opportunities to use: 

  • AI-enabled tools 

  • automation 

  • data-driven insights 

  • Awareness of responsible AI concepts: 

  • human oversight 

  • data quality 

  • explainability 

  • privacy 

  • risk awareness 

  • Experience using digital tools to improve: 

  • documentation 

  • analysis 

  • requirements refinement 

  • reporting 

  • Curiosity / willingness to build fluency in: 

  • emerging technologies 

  • AI-assisted product development 

  • intelligent operations 

 

Soft Skills & Other Qualities 

  • Strong communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex payment processes into business and technical requirements. 

  • High attention to detail, especially in compliance- and risk-sensitive environments. 

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-pressure setting. 

  • Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional team and across different time zones

 This internship brings together the best of general merchandise and fashion under one roof. It’s all about helping you grow into a future leader in buying and merchandising—while working with great people, developing exciting products, and working on real commercial challenges.  Salary: £26,000 Programme start date: 14 June 2027

About us

You might know us as a supermarket, technology company or even for our award-winning mobile network. Truth is, we’re all those things, and much more. Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. The Director, Devices & Micro Product is responsible for leading a portfolio of >$150M within Lab Filtration, spanning devices, microbiology and collection solutions that customers rely on to support critical research, life science manufacturing, and applied market workflows. This leader will shape the strategy, performance, and growth of the portfolio, driving customer value, innovation, and commercial execution across a global business.


This position reports to the VP, GM Diagnostics & Genomics and Lab Filtration and is part of the D&G & LF leadership team, part of Discovery and Medical Operating company located in Cardiff (UK), Amersham (UK) or Marlborough (US) offices and will be an on-site role


What you will do:

• Develop and execute the strategic plan for the Lab Filtration Devices & Micro portfolio, owning the end-to-end product strategy across growth, profitability, lifecycle management, and market positioning.

• Ensure portfolio performance delivers against CVD and key business KPIs, leading PSP problem-solving to identify root causes and implement countermeasures across the portfolio.

• Contribute to the overall strategic direction of the Lab Filtration business and the broader D&G & LF leadership agenda as a member of the leadership team.

• Drive the innovation pipeline for Devices & Micro, ensuring a clear flow of customer-backed projects that meet IFV/IPV targets and strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the portfolio.

• Partner cross-functionally with R&D, operations, quality, supply chain, and commercial teams to deliver successful NPD execution, product launches, and lifecycle initiatives.

• Build strong segment and customer insight to identify opportunities in lab filtration, microbiology, and sample preparation workflows, translating market needs into clear portfolio actions.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 5 direct reports, fostering a high-performance culture with clear priorities, strong accountability, and regular feedback.



Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, marketing, or portfolio leadership, preferably within life sciences, lab filtration, bioprocessing, microbiology, applied markets, or related consumables and devices portfolios
  • Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, operations, quality, supply chain, and commercial teams to deliver new product development (NPD) and lifecycle management initiatives
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including direct management of product management teams
  • Demonstrated experience managing product portfolios with P&L responsibility and delivering against revenue and margin targets in a global B2B environment

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel internationally – up to 35% of the time and up to consecutive weeks

Job Description

Are you interested in delivering impactful business results? In this newly established global role, you will lead the successful delivery and adoption of strategic capabilities across Global Commercial Operations (GCO).  Working across Demand Planning, Order Management, Performance Management, and Product and Digital teams, you will ensure new processes, operating models, and ways of working are successfully implemented, adopted, and embedded within the organization. 

The role combines business delivery leadership, organizational readiness, change execution, and capability development to help GCO continuously evolve and improve how it operates – what an amazing job opportunity, is not it?

Core Responsibilities:

Lead Strategic Business Delivery

  • Lead delivery of major GCO initiatives and operating model changes.
  • Translate strategic priorities into executable plans and measurable business outcomes.
  • Coordinate delivery across functions and stakeholders to ensure successful execution.

Drive Organizational Readiness and Adoption

  • Lead business readiness, change management, and adoption activities for new processes and ways of working.
  • Ensure teams are prepared to successfully operate within future-state operating models.
  • Partner with Digital Deployment Managers to align business adoption with technology deployments.

Build and Embed Organizational Capabilities

  • Identify capability gaps and develop training, enablement, and capability-building plans across GCO.
  • Ensure new capabilities, processes, and ways of working become embedded within day-to-day operations.
  • Support the continued evolution of Demand Planning, Order Management, and Performance Management capabilities.

Strengthen Delivery Excellence

  • Establish consistent approaches for project delivery, change management, business readiness, and implementation.
  • Develop frameworks, tools, and best practices that improve execution effectiveness across GCO initiatives.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment and remove barriers to successful implementation.

Realize Business Value From Change

  • Ensure strategic initiatives deliver their intended business outcomes.
  • Monitor adoption and identify barriers preventing realization of expected benefits.
  • Partner with Commercial Operations Performance to measure impact and drive corrective actions where required.

Play your part in our team succeeding

Global Commercial Operations is responsible for how demand is planned, how orders are managed, and how performance is improved across the LEGO Group. As GCO continues to evolve through initiatives such as Aurora, Quote-to-Fulfill, and future process improvements, success depends not only on defining the right processes and technologies, but also on ensuring they are successfully adopted and embedded within the organization. This role plays a critical role in bridging strategy and execution by helping the business successfully implement new capabilities, adopt new ways of working, and realize intended business outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Significant experience leading large-scale business transformation, operating model change, or strategic capability-building initiatives
  • Strong program and project delivery experience, including managing complex cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Practical experience in Demand Planning, Order Management, Commercial Planning, Supply Chain, or a related business function
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategic objectives into executable implementation plans and measurable business outcomes
  • Experience leading organizational readiness, change management, business adoption, and capability-building activities
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, navigate organizational change, and drive execution across complex environments
  • Experience building training, enablement, or capability-development programs
  • Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2), Change Management (Prosci), Lean, Agile, or similar methodologies
  • Experience working in a global consumer products, retail, or omnichannel business environment

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced production, manufacturing, warehouse, or logistics professional looking to take the next step into leadership while remaining actively involved in day-to-day operations.

Working closely with site leadership, you'll play a key role in delivering operational excellence, developing people, and ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead by example within the operational area, providing guidance, coaching, and support to team members.
  • Support day-to-day production activities, stepping in where required to ensure operational continuity and performance.
  • Ensure adherence to site policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  • Promote and maintain a strong health and safety culture across the operation.
  • Monitor operational performance and help drive improvements in efficiency and productivity.
  • Act as a key point of contact for operational issues, identifying solutions and escalating where appropriate.
  • Lead daily shift handovers and communicate key updates and priorities to the team.
  • Support workforce planning, including holiday management and absence control.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth site operations.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and support the implementation of best practices.
  • Deputise for the Site Lead when required.

What You'll Do

  • Supervise, coach, and develop employees to maximise performance and engagement.
  • Lead daily shift briefs and communicate operational KPIs.
  • Drive a zero-harm culture and support incident investigations and root cause analysis.
  • Own safety, quality, and production controls within your area of responsibility.
  • Build strong working relationships with operational stakeholders.
  • Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality standards.
  • Support training and development activities across the team.
  • Analyse operational data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Support site leadership in achieving key business objectives.

What We Need From You

  • Minimum 3 years' experience within a production, manufacturing, warehouse, or logistics environment.
  • Previous experience leading, motivating, or supervising teams.
  • Experience within Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement environments is advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of health, safety, and quality standards.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and self-motivated.
  • Ability to influence and engage colleagues at all levels.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong leadership, change management, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

26WD100930, Customer Advocate, Design & Manufacturing, Customer Reliability


Position overview 

Autodesk Customer Technical Success is looking for an experienced Design & Manufacturing customer advocate to identify the systemic customer problems that matter most and turn those signals into clear decisions and measurable outcomes. 


The Customer Advocate brings together customer advocacy and product intelligence skills into one role. You will bring Design & Manufacturing product and workflow knowledge together with customer conversations, support trends, escalations, product data, sentiment, and business context to understand what is really happening, determine where Autodesk should invest attention, and build a clear case for action.   


Your value comes from applying technical expertise and judgment to customer signals, developing a point of view, validating it with customers and internal partners, and driving systemic issues toward a clear solution path. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technical Support, Technical Account Management, Support Readiness, Customer Success, and other teams across Autodesk. 


Responsibilities 

  • Identify, validate, and prioritize systemic customer pain using Support data, customer conversations, escalations, telemetry, sentiment, and other signals, distinguishing isolated incidents from issues with broader or growing impact
  • Build a clear understanding of Design & Manufacturing customer workflows and validate customer pain directly with customers, account teams, Technical Account Managers, Support specialists, and other relevant partners
  • Build decision-ready Reliability Packages that combine customer evidence, quantitative data, business impact, and strategic context
  • Develop a point of view on potential solution paths, including Product or Engineering changes, diagnostics, supportability improvements, workflow guidance, digital solutions, communications, or other approaches
  • Connect systemic customer pain to Autodesk and Product strategic priorities so teams can make informed decisions about where investment can create the greatest customer and business value
  • Drive prioritized issues toward a clear decision and accountable owner, and escalate when ownership or alignment cannot be established
  • Help bring structure to complex work by getting the right people aligned, making ownership clear, and keeping priority issues moving forward
  • Build trusted relationships with Design & Manufacturing Product Management and Engineering teams and bring customer intelligence into roadmap, reliability, planning, and prioritization discussions
  • Use strategic customer escalations as a source of intelligence when they expose systemic risk, significant customer impact, or problems likely to scale, without replacing standard account or Support escalation processes
  • Represent the voice of the customer through direct engagement, advisory groups, support interactions, customer sentiment, community signals, and other feedback channels
  • Partner with Support Readiness to translate decisions, workarounds, Product changes, and resolved customer pain into scalable guidance for customer-facing teams and, where appropriate, customers
  • Follow prioritized issues through the Reliability value chain and evaluate whether the resulting Product, supportability, or operational action reduced customer pain
  • Use modern data, analytics, and AI-assisted tools to accelerate signal identification and synthesis while applying human judgment and product expertise to conclusions and recommendations



Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, customer advocacy, product insights, product operations, product management, or a related customer-facing or product-facing discipline
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Autodesk Fusion, Autodesk Inventor, or comparable professional CAD/CAM software, with the ability to understand complex Design & Manufacturing workflows, product behavior, and technical customer issues
  • Strong analytical judgment and pattern-recognition skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information and make recommendations with incomplete or ambiguous data
  • Experience developing compelling business cases or problem narratives that connect evidence, customer impact, business impact, and recommended action
  • Demonstrated ability to independently structure and lead ambiguous, cross-functional work, align stakeholders and dependencies, and influence Product Management, Engineering, and senior leaders without direct authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex customer and technical problems for Product and executive audiences
  • Ability to prioritize a limited number of high-impact issues and maintain focus in an environment with competing customer, Product, and organizational demands
  • Comfort using modern data, analytics, and AI-assisted tools to investigate customer signals and develop an informed point of view

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience working directly with Product Management and Engineering on product quality, reliability, defect prioritization, or roadmap decisions
  • Experience supporting strategic or enterprise Design & Manufacturing customers and understanding the technical and business context behind high-impact customer issues
  • Broader familiarity with Design & Manufacturing workflows such as CAD, CAM, data management, collaboration, or manufacturing processes
  • Experience with customer advisory programs, Voice of Customer programs, systemic issue management, or problem-management practices
  • Experience developing scalable approaches that reduce recurring customer issues or improve product and customer experience outcomes

26WD100930, Chargé de la défense des intérêts des clients, Conception et fabrication, Fiabilité client


Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Customer Technical Success » d'Autodesk recherche un chargé de la relation client expérimenté dans le domaine de la conception et de la fabrication, capable d'identifier les problèmes systémiques les plus importants rencontrés par les clients et de transformer ces signaux en décisions claires et en résultats mesurables.


Le chargé de la défense des intérêts des clients combine dans une seule fonction des compétences en matière de défense des intérêts des clients et d’analyse des produits. Vous associez votre connaissance des produits et des flux de travail de Design & Manufacturing aux échanges avec les clients, aux tendances en matière d’assistance, aux escalades, aux données produit, au sentiment des clients et au contexte commercial afin de comprendre ce qui se passe réellement, de déterminer les domaines sur lesquels Autodesk doit concentrer son attention et d’élaborer un argumentaire clair en faveur d’une action.


Votre valeur réside dans la capacité à appliquer votre expertise technique et votre jugement aux signaux émis par les clients, à développer un point de vue, à le valider auprès des clients et des partenaires internes, et à orienter les problèmes systémiques vers une voie claire menant à une solution. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la gestion des produits, l’ingénierie, le support technique, la gestion technique des comptes, la préparation du support, la réussite client et d’autres équipes au sein d’Autodesk.


Responsabilités

  • Identifier, valider et hiérarchiser les difficultés systémiques des clients à l’aide des données du support, des échanges avec les clients, des escalades, de la télémétrie, du sentiment et d’autres signaux, en distinguant les incidents isolés des problèmes ayant un impact plus large ou croissant
  • Acquérir une compréhension claire des flux de travail des clients du secteur de la conception et de la fabrication et valider les difficultés des clients directement auprès de ces derniers, des équipes chargées des comptes, des responsables techniques de compte, des spécialistes du support et d’autres partenaires concernés

  • Relier les difficultés systémiques des clients aux priorités stratégiques d’Autodesk et des produits afin que les équipes puissent prendre des décisions éclairées sur les domaines d’investissement susceptibles de créer la plus grande valeur pour les clients et l’entreprise
  • Faire aboutir les problèmes prioritaires à une décision claire et à la désignation d’un responsable, et les remonter lorsque la responsabilité ou l’alignement ne peuvent être établis
  • Contribuer à structurer les tâches complexes en alignant les bonnes personnes, en clarifiant les responsabilités et en assurant l’avancement des problèmes prioritaires
  • Établir des relations de confiance avec les équipes de gestion des produits de conception et de fabrication ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, et intégrer les informations clients dans les discussions relatives à la feuille de route, à la fiabilité, à la planification et à la hiérarchisation des priorités

  • Représentez la voix du client par le biais d’un engagement direct, de groupes consultatifs, d’interactions avec le support, du sentiment client, des signaux émanant de la communauté et d’autres canaux de retour d’information

  • Suivez les problèmes prioritaires tout au long de la chaîne de valeur de la fiabilité et évaluez si le produit, la facilité de support ou les mesures opérationnelles qui en ont résulté ont permis de réduire les difficultés rencontrées par les clients
  • Utiliser des données modernes, des analyses et des outils assistés par l’IA pour accélérer l’identification et la synthèse des signaux, tout en appliquant le jugement humain et l’expertise produit aux conclusions et recommandations

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le support technique, la gestion technique des comptes, la défense des intérêts des clients, l’analyse produit, les opérations produit, la gestion de produit ou toute autre discipline connexe en contact avec la clientèle ou les produits
  • Solides connaissances pratiques d’Autodesk Fusion, d’Autodesk Inventor ou d’un logiciel CAO/FAO professionnel comparable, avec la capacité de comprendre les flux de travail complexes de conception et de fabrication, le comportement des produits et les problèmes techniques rencontrés par les clients
  • Solides capacités d’analyse et de reconnaissance de schémas, avec la capacité de synthétiser des informations quantitatives et qualitatives et de formuler des recommandations à partir de données incomplètes ou ambiguës
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration d’analyses de rentabilité convaincantes ou de descriptions de problèmes reliant les preuves, l’impact sur les clients, l’impact sur l’activité et les actions recommandées
  • Capacité avérée à structurer et diriger de manière autonome des missions transversales et ambiguës, à coordonner les parties prenantes et les interdépendances, et à influencer la gestion des produits, l’ingénierie et les cadres supérieurs sans autorité hiérarchique directe
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, notamment la capacité à simplifier des problèmes techniques et clients complexes à l’intention des équipes produit et des dirigeants
  • Capacité à hiérarchiser un nombre limité de problèmes à fort impact et à rester concentré dans un environnement où s’entrecroisent les exigences des clients, des produits et de l’organisation
  • Aisance dans l’utilisation d’outils modernes de données, d’analyse et d’intelligence artificielle pour étudier les signaux des clients et développer un point de vue éclairé

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Expérience de collaboration directe avec la gestion de produit et l’ingénierie sur des questions de qualité des produits, de fiabilité, de hiérarchisation des défauts ou de décisions relatives à la feuille de route

jobTitle: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA
jobDescription:

Your future team

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA at Atlassian, you’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian’s AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.

What you’ll do

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, and retain top talent for your team and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

  • Mentor and coach your forward-deployed engineering team on best practices in AI/ML solution design, code quality, scalable architecture, testing, debugging, and documentation—ensuring rapid, high-quality delivery of customer-focused, production-ready solutions.

  • Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.

  • Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement.

  • Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership.

  • Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results.

Your background

On the first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience managing software engineering teams at scale.

  • Experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development.

  • Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).

  • Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

It's great, but not required, if you have:

  • Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.

  • Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale.

  • Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

In this role, you'll be part of the Customer Success Architect team within the Sales and Success department, focusing on the adoption of Atlassian's AI platform, Rovo. As a CSA (AI), you'll execute time-boxed, co-built technical engagements that take customers from "Rovo is turned on" to real, measurable business value in production. You'll partner directly with enterprise teams to discover high-impact AI use cases, design and build custom Rovo agents, configure third-party connectors, and deploy working solutions into production workflows. Your role bridges deep AI and Atlassian platform expertise with customer success, focusing on measurable adoption outcomes. Your work will involve managing engagements, enabling customers, and continuously improving processes to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

We're hiring a CSA (with an AI focus) to join our Customer Success Architect team, reporting to a regional leader. This is not a managerial role. Atlassian CSAs are technical experts with Atlassian solutions, delivering guidance to drive value realization and adoption. CSAs are accomplished at delivering performant technical guidance at scale, aligning product capabilities with business needs and desired outcomes. They partner with Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Product teams to provide solutions and technical guidance to help customers achieve their desired outcomes and goals.

You will help our strongest promoters showcase their successes to their peers and serve as the tip of the spear in expanding the reach of AI and the Atlassian System of Work into new use cases and markets. Atlassian CSAs aim to help customers get the most out of their Atlassian investment.

On your first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Discovery. Facilitate use case discovery workshops with customer teams to identify high-impact, high-value AI opportunities. Understand their workflows, pain points, and where Rovo agents and search can deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Design. Co-build custom Rovo agents and configure third-party connectors alongside customer teams. Customers are hands-on keyboard. Design solutions tailored to their workflows using the Atlassian platform (Jira, Confluence, Rovo Studio).

  • Deploy. Guide customers from sandbox to production. Validate that agents are performing, connectors are flowing data, and teams are enabled to iterate and scale independently post-engagement.

  • Collaborate. Work with Account Teams and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to plan customer-specific activation journeys and hand off for sustained growth.

  • Advocate. Meet with Rovo Product, Engineering, and AI teams to surface product friction, share field patterns, and improve the adoption motion.

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally for events and customer meetings.

*This position is UK based.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Your background

  • Technical Aptitude: Experience with AI platforms, the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Rovo), and technical product demos. Familiarity with building AI agents, prompt engineering, and configuring integrations between enterprise knowledge sources and AI systems. Hands-on experience helping organizations adopt and operationalize AI tools in production environments.

  • Solution Area Expertise: Specialized knowledge in enterprise workflows across product development, IT service management, or business operations. Understanding how AI agents and automation can improve processes such as incident response, backlog management, knowledge discovery, and cross-team collaboration. Familiarity with third-party connector ecosystems (Google Drive, SharePoint, Slack, GitHub, etc.).

  • Product Mindset & Communication: Strong product mindset, able to shape technical solutions for business impact, and comfortable owning problems end-to-end from discovery to deployment. Effective communicator who can influence stakeholders and explain AI concepts to varied audiences. Delivers durable solutions but can quickly prototype when needed. Ability to translate AI capabilities into tangible outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.

What you can expect

The Head of Customer Success, EMEA will be responsible for overall revenue retention and product adoption of a large portfolio of customers and ARR, leading and mentoring regional customer success teams across EMEA. You will execute on regional strategy for customer satisfaction, retention and growth in coordination with the global customer success organization and strategy. Country: United Kingdom

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Retail & Commercial Banking I Digital & Assisted Channels; is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

The Private Banking & Select Investment teams are structured to provide regulated advice on financial services and investment products tailored to meet long-term investment needs of the clients within the segment.

Santander is looking for a Select Investment Advisor based out of Birmingham.

A dream holiday. Early retirement. Sending a loved one to university. Some of our customers have big plans for their money, and that’s where you come in. By providing them with clear informed advice about their investment options, you’ll help to make those plans a reality.

If you have experience in providing customers with investment advice and see your future as a key colleague in our branch network, this could be your opportunity to become a Select Investment Advisor.

It’s a premium service: you’ll be working with customers looking to invest for at least five years or more. You’ll listen to their needs, clarify their objectives and analyse their circumstances. Where appropriate, you’ll explain which of our award-winning investment products are right for them.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Providing regulated investment advice to help clients meet their objectives. Representing Santander Select and investments in Branch.

  • Demonstrating deep understanding of wider financial affairs and financial products to ensure that knowledge is comprehensive, and client focused.

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

  • Salary Range: 

  • £47,142.00 - £70,714.00 per annum (depending on experience)

  • This salary range represents the expected remuneration for the role. Annual salary is based on a standard 35-hour working week. Actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, qualifications and location.

  • £500 annual cash allowance to spend on our great range of benefits. 

  • 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 28 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.

  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments

  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.

  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans. 

  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services

  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.

  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.

  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.

  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.

  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

Description Overview

In this role you will act as the Quality lead for assigned production issues and strategic quality themes, providing oversight, continuity and challenge to strengthen operational quality processes, controls and governance.

You will identify recurring risks and systemic issues, ensure learning is translated into sustainable improvements, and support effective management of quality risk within manufacturing operations.

Scope of the Role

  • Maintain oversight of assigned quality themes and recurring quality issues, identifying trends, emerging risks and systemic failure modes.
  • Connect learning across deviations, complaints, audits and operational events to ensure sustainable risk reduction and continuous improvement.
  • Provide Quality leadership and oversight during significant quality issues, investigations and escalations.
  • Challenge investigation scope, root cause analysis and proposed actions to ensure quality risks are appropriately addressed.
  • Support the development and implementation of robust, risk-based operational quality controls and processes.
  • Monitor effectiveness of improvements and escalate where issues continue to recur or controls remain ineffective.
  • Partner with Operations and other functions to ensure quality risks are identified, understood and effectively managed.
  • Provide Quality input to change controls, validation activities and operational improvement initiatives where required.
  • Support site quality governance through data analysis, trend monitoring and risk-based recommendations.
  • Undertake such other reasonable duties as may be required from time to time in order to support the Perrigo business.

Experience Required

  • Must hold a degree or equivalent qualification in a science, engineering or related discipline.
  • Experience within a regulated manufacturing environment, preferably pharmaceutical or healthcare.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of pharmaceutical legislation and a good understanding of GMPs, Quality Systems and Quality Risk Management Principles.
  • Experience analysing quality data, trends and recurring issues to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Strong investigation, problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Effective technical writing and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and provide constructive challenge.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Benefits

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits tailored to supporting you and your family, as well as career development opportunities to ensure you feel valued and supported, both professionally and personally.

ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of "Contributing to Society through Healthcare" by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Software Engineer, Quality & Process will utilise their extensive experience in Software Quality Assurance, particularly in cloud solutions used in medical applications and embedded medical device development. This role will play a critical role in ensuring our cloud platform and medical devices meet the stringent quality and regulatory standards required for medical devices.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-growing organisation in a strategic role that will have significant impact on the company's digital offering and contribute to how organ transplants are delivered. While this position is in the Software Development team, the role works in partnership with the quality function.

This is an on-site position in Oxford with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Software Engineer, Quality & Process will be responsible for:

Quality Assurance & Testing:

  • Development, implementation and maintenance of the Software Technical File for the products, defining the documental strategy and facilitating submissions
  • Act as primary interface between Software and Quality and Regulatory teams
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of software processes that meets all relevant Regulatory requirements, including but not limited to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Working Instructions (WI)
  • Define and execute improvements activities, including but not limited to Corrective Actions Preventive Actions (CAPAs)
  • Oversee the SOUP (Software of Unknown Provenance) and Tools validations securing compliance with internal QMS (Quality Management System)


Compliance & Documentation:

  • Create all the software related documentation, including requirements, design, test reports and traceability, ensuring compliance and excellence in the rigour applied including derived outcome.
  • Develop templates for software documentation and facilitate their integration with the software development toolchain, including the Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) artifacts.
  • Proactively manage partnerships, preparing and maintaining detailed documentation, including test plans, test cases, test scripts and test reports.


Risk and Cybersecurity Risk Management:

  • Drive the software risk analysis activities, including the development and maintenance of the Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA), identification of mitigations and their inclusion in the design input documentation
  • Drive the cybersecurity activities including threat modelling, penetration tests, identification, assessment and mitigation of software-related and cybersecurity risks, including those associated with the outsourced development and testing processes.
  • Drive a key focus to develop and maintain a risk management plan in accordance with relevant standards and frameworks, ensuring all identified risks are documented and mitigated effectively.
  • Take the lead to ensure regular and comprehensive review and update of software related risk through the software FMEA, to address any emerging risks during the software development lifecycle.


Collaboration & Communication:

  • Role models effective stakeholder collaboration, working closely with software developers, product managers and other partners to understand requirements and design effective testing strategies.
  • Ensures timely communication of findings, risks and recommendations, which are effective and clear to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adhere to and role model the spirit of OrganOx's Code of Conduct and all other company policies


Requirements


Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in a similar role, preferably within the medical device industry.
  • Proven experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on cloud solutions and software for Medical Devices (essential)
  • Strong understanding of software development, testing methodologies, tools and processes (essential)
  • Proven experience applying regulatory standards for Medical Devices (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA regulations, EN 62304, IEC 62366) (essential)
  • Engineering experience in software risk management (ISO 14971), including cybersecurity risk management (essential)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail (essential)
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills (essential)
  • Proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and IoMT solutions (desirable)
  • Knowledge of medical device software lifecycle processes (essential)
  • Familiarity in programming languages such as Python, Java, C# or C/C++ (desirable)
  • Proven experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines (desirable)
  • Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (essential)


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in software quality assurance or testing (e.g., ISTQB).

The Role:

The Product Assurance team at CoMind is responsible for ensuring the device performs as intended against its specified requirements, generating the test evidence needed to support regulatory submissions and design history files. Working across hardware, software, and integrated system levels, the team designs and executes test methods and protocols that demonstrate design outputs meet design inputs to the standard required for FDA clearance and CE marking.

As a Verification Test Engineer, you will contribute to the design and execution of V&V test activities for CoMind’s device, working across hardware, software, and system levels. You will develop test protocols, validate the test methods and equipment, execute testing, analyse and collate results, and author reports for a regulated medical device, working closely with systems engineering and quality throughout. As a member of the Product Assurance team the role reports into the Systems and V+V Manager.

You will have a good scientific and engineering background with a rigorous and systematic approach to problem solving, product testing and product integration.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and execute test protocols for hardware, software, and system-level design verification testing
  • Develop and qualify test methods, test equipment and protocols against system and sub-system requirements
  • Collate and analyse test results, identify and report anomalies and non-conformances, and work with quality and engineering teams to investigate root causes and determine disposition
  • Author verification test reports to the standard required for design history files and regulatory submissions, including FDA clearance and CE marking
  • Maintain requirements traceability matrices, ensuring test coverage is complete and gaps are identified and resolved ahead of design reviews and regulatory milestones
  • Support system integration testing, coordinating test execution across hardware, firmware, and software components and documenting integration test outcomes
  • Contribute to risk management activities under ISO 14971, including review of FMEAs and verification of risk control effectiveness
  • Develop and maintain test infrastructure, fixtures, calibration status and tooling needed to execute verification activities efficiently and repeatably
  • AI is fundamental to our culture — it’s not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively

Skills & Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in verification, test engineering, or a closely related role, with hands-on experience writing and executing test protocols for complex hardware or software systems
  • Experience in a regulated industry (medical devices, aerospace, automotive, or similar) and design control requirements
  • Good analytical skills, with the ability to identify and investigate test anomalies, document non-conformances, and support root cause analysis
  • Experience in developing software based test tools and scripts in Python for collecting and analyzing test data
  • Familiarity with requirements management tooling and test management platforms
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills, with experience authoring test protocols and reports that meet regulatory documentation standards

Nice to have:

  • Working knowledge of ISO 14971 and ISO 13485 applied to product design and development
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop or software-in-the-loop testing for embedded or real-time systems
  • Experience in optical, photonic, or biomedical hardware test and characterisation
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304 software V&V requirements and the interface between hardware and software test activities
  • Exposure to automated test frameworks or scripting for test automation in an embedded or mixed-signal context

Company description


Mitra Bio has developed a non-invasive skin sampling that can detect molecular changes in the skin non-invasively. The Company has been awarded the prestigious European Innovation Council grant to develop a non-invasive molecular test for screening moles suspected of melanoma.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the opportunity to increase the commitment as the programme develops.


Role description


You’ll lead the regulatory and quality activities for Mitra Bio’s melanoma diagnostic programme, which includes a non-invasive sampling medical device and a next-generation sequencing-based molecular test for cancer.


This is a hands-on role for someone who has previously taken a medical device or IVD through regulatory approval and to market. You’ll lead the preparation of technical documentation and regulatory submissions, develop and maintain our Quality Management System, and act as Mitra Bio’s key regulatory contact with external regulatory bodies and partners.

You’ll work closely with our product, scientific and clinical teams to ensure regulatory requirements are incorporated throughout product development and that our clinical and analytical evidence meets submission requirements.


You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading the regulatory activities to achieve CE marking of Mitra Bio’s melanoma diagnostic test and sampling device in compliance with IVDR and MDR
  • Developing, implementing and maintaining Mitra Bio's Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 13485
  • Leading preparation of technical documentation and regulatory submissions under applicable UK and EU medical device and IVD regulations
  • Managing interactions with relevant regulatory authorities, UK Approved Bodies, EU Notified Bodies and other external regulatory partners
  • Leading or supporting product and organisational registrations, including EUDAMED and relevant UK requirements
  • Providing regulatory oversight of verification and validation activities, ensuring clinical and analytical evidence meets submission requirements
  • Establishing appropriate post-market surveillance, complaints handling and regulatory reporting processes
  • Advising product, scientific and clinical teams on regulatory requirements throughout product development
  • Ensuring regulatory requirements are translated into practical development plans, documentation and milestones
  • Liaising with the hospitals, clinical trials team and stakeholders to ensure the smooth operation of our melanoma diagnostic programme


About you


You’re an experienced Regulatory Affairs and/or Quality Assurance professional with a strong background in IVDs and hands-on experience taking medical devices or IVDs through regulatory approval.


You have strong working knowledge of EU MDR and/or IVDR and ISO 13485, and you’re comfortable taking hands-on ownership of regulatory and quality activities. 


You should apply if you have:

  • Significant professional experience in Regulatory Affairs and/or Quality Assurance within the IVD industry
  • Hands-on experience with EU medical device regulatory approvals and CE marking under EU MDR and/or IVDR, with preference for experience with high-complexity Class C IVDs
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485 and medical device quality management systems
  • Experience preparing and managing technical documentation and regulatory submissions
  • Experience working directly with regulatory authorities, Approved Bodies and/or Notified Bodies

It would be particularly useful if you also have:

  • EUDAMED registration experience

  • Familiarity with genomics, next-generation sequencing or molecular diagnostic workflows
  • Experience establishing or scaling a QMS within an early-stage biotechnology or diagnostics company


Mitra Bio is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Company Overview

Xstrahl is proud to be an industry leading medical technology company that designs clinical and research systems to help eradicate cancer. For more than 20 years, Xstrahl has been shaping the development of superficial and orthovoltage therapies for cancer treatment and advancing pre-clinical research. Xstrahl systems are in operation at more than 700 treatment and research facilities worldwide.

Are you a passionate problem solver who enjoys working with a meaningful mission?

With recent growth, we are looking to hire a Test Engineer to join our team in Brownhills, Walsall. This position provides an exciting opportunity to directly impact the quality of patient treatment worldwide. The Test Engineer will be responsible for understanding the product requirements and its features and executing the test scripts and procedures written by the project team to test the product.

What’s involved?

As a Test Engineer, reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you’ll provide prompt and professional engineering support to Xstrahl therapy and research cabinet systems worldwide — putting the mechanical, electromechanical and electronic hardware that make up our X-ray therapy platforms through their paces, alongside the software that drives them. You’ll execute the test scripts and procedures set by the project team, In order to achieve this, your responsibilities will include:

  • Attending meetings with the design team to understand the product details and the test scripts to be executed (for example, intended use, requirements, software design, and hardware design).
  • Executing approved test plans, test cases and test scripts (including usability testing) for the products (software and hardware), following documented procedures precisely.
  • Carrying out automated and manual test scripts as instructed, and flagging opportunities for improvement to the project team.
  • Reporting product quality issues and working with the team in resolving the issues.
  • Following all tests and procedures in line with the Company’s Quality Management System and Regulatory standards.
  • Accurately recording and documenting test results to support regulatory submission.

What does it take to be successful?

Precision and rigour will be fundamental in this role — as a Test Engineer you’ll follow documented test scripts and procedures. This will naturally require an individual who has a meticulous eye for detail and the discipline to execute tests consistently and repeatably, rather than someone looking to define the test strategy themselves. In addition, you’ll also need:

  • A relevant engineering background (Mechanical, Electromechanical, Manufacturing, Biomedical, or similar) is helpful, but no specific degree is required — what matters most is hands-on experience testing electromechanical or hardware systems.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in testing hardware or electromechanical products (software testing experience is a plus, not essential).
  • Working knowledge of Medical Products Quality Management System.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborative approach towards problem solving.
  • Experience in Medical/Life Sciences radiation products (desirable).
  • Experience in Agile Methodology (desirable)
  • Experience in creating documentation/report for regulatory compliance (FDA, CE etc) (desirable).

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous annual bonus scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Access to an award winning Employee Assistance Program with 24/7 support
  • Opportunity to learn and grow with a personal development plan
